tools.name: mcp__Claude_Browser__computer
tools.description: Mouse/keyboard automation in the Browser pane. Clicks accept either `coordinate` (pixels in the coordinate frame of the most recent `computer{action:"screenshot"}` — reported with every scaled screenshot; equal to the image's pixels for unscaled ones) or `ref` (a `ref_N` from read_page/find). Whenever you intend to click on an element like an icon, you should consult a screenshot to determine the coordinates of the element first; after the tab loads a different site, take a new screenshot before clicking by `coordinate`.

schema.name: mcp__Claude_Browser__computer
schema.description: Mouse/keyboard automation in the Browser pane. Clicks accept either `coordinate` (pixels in the coordinate frame of the most recent `computer{action:"screenshot"}` — reported with every scaled screenshot; equal to the image's pixels for unscaled ones) or `ref` (a `ref_N` from read_page/find). Whenever you intend to click on an element like an icon, you should consult a screenshot to determine the coordinates of the element first; after the tab loads a different site, take a new screenshot before clicking by `coordinate`.

tabId.description: Tab to act on within the preview context. Omit for the fronted tab; get ids from tabs_context.

action.description:
The action to perform:
* `left_click`: Click the left mouse button at the specified coordinates.
* `right_click`: Click the right mouse button at the specified coordinates to open context menus.
* `double_click`: Double-click the left mouse button at the specified coordinates.
* `triple_click`: Triple-click the left mouse button at the specified coordinates.
* `type`: Type a string of text.
* `screenshot`: Take a screenshot of the screen.
* `wait`: Wait for a specified number of seconds.
* `scroll`: Scroll up, down, left, or right at the specified coordinates.
* `key`: Press a specific keyboard key.
* `left_click_drag`: Drag from start_coordinate to coordinate.
* `zoom`: Take a screenshot of a specific region for closer inspection.
* `scroll_to`: Scroll an element into view using its element reference ID from read_page or find tools.
* `hover`: Move the mouse cursor to the specified coordinates or element without clicking. Useful for revealing tooltips, dropdown menus, or triggering hover states.

coordinate.description: (x, y): The x (pixels from the left edge) and y (pixels from the top edge) coordinates. Required for `left_click`, `right_click`, `double_click`, `triple_click`, and `scroll`. For `left_click_drag`, this is the end position.

text.description: The text to type (for `type` action) or the key(s) to press (for `key` action). For `key` action: Provide space-separated keys (e.g., "Backspace Backspace Delete"). Supports keyboard shortcuts using the platform's modifier key (use "cmd" on Mac, "ctrl" on Windows/Linux, e.g., "cmd+a" or "ctrl+a" for select all). Page zoom shortcuts (e.g. "cmd+=", "ctrl+-", "cmd+0") are not supported - use the `zoom` action to magnify a region of the page instead.

duration.description: The number of seconds to wait. Required for `wait`. Maximum 10 seconds.

scroll_direction.description: The direction to scroll. Required for `scroll`.

scroll_amount.description: The number of scroll wheel ticks. Optional for `scroll`, defaults to 3.

region.description: (x0, y0, x1, y1): The rectangular region to capture for `zoom`. Coordinates define a rectangle from top-left (x0, y0) to bottom-right (x1, y1) in pixels from the viewport origin. Required for `zoom` action. Useful for inspecting small UI elements like icons, buttons, or text.

scale.description: For `screenshot` and `zoom` only. Scale factor in [0.1, 1] for the returned image; 1 (default) uses the full image token budget, 0.5 returns an image at half the width and height (~quarter of the tokens). Coordinates are ALWAYS in the full-resolution coordinate frame (reported with every scaled screenshot), never in the scaled image's own pixels.

repeat.description: Number of times to repeat the key sequence. Only applicable for `key` action. Must be a positive integer between 1 and 100. Default is 1. Useful for navigation tasks like pressing arrow keys multiple times.

ref.description: Element reference ID from read_page or find tools (e.g., "ref_1", "ref_2"). Required for `scroll_to` action. Can be used as alternative to `coordinate` for click actions.

modifiers.description: Modifier keys for click actions. Supports: "ctrl", "shift", "alt", "cmd" (or "meta"), "win" (or "windows"). Can be combined with "+" (e.g., "ctrl+shift", "cmd+alt"). Optional.

action_summary.description: A few words saying what this action does on the page and to what, for example 'Sends the drafted reply to pat@example.com' or 'Opens the Filters menu'. Set it on every left_click, right_click, double_click, triple_click, left_click_drag, key and type action. State the effect only, and accurately: no reasons, nothing about what you were asked or allowed to do, no passwords or other secrets.

tools.name: mcp__Claude_Browser__resize_window
tools.description: Emulate a viewport size in the Browser pane tab. Presets: mobile (375x812), tablet (768x1024), or desktop, which clears the size emulation and returns the tab to the pane's own responsive size. Custom sizes need both width and height. An emulated size applies to that tab across reloads and navigation (scaled down to fit when it is larger than the pane): reset it with preset "desktop" as soon as you finish testing. The desktop app may also clear a size you set when your turn ends, so set it again in a later turn if you still need it. A size the user picked from the pane's own Viewport menu is theirs and stays until they or you change it; leave it unless they ask. colorScheme (light/dark) emulates prefers-color-scheme on that tab; it survives reloads and preset "desktop" does not touch it, but the pane re-syncs the tab to the app's light/dark theme when that theme changes or the pane reopens; local documents and static HTML previews always render light. The mobile preset (and any width < 768) also emulates a mobile device: Android Chrome user agent and 5 touch points, so pages detect a touch phone; your clicks still arrive as mouse clicks. action.description: What to do. 'attach' opens the live simulator panel for the user — call it BEFORE you build or launch, as soon as the user wants to see the app: on a booted simulator it opens immediately, and otherwise it returns a clear, harmless error (boot or build first, then retry it). Do not skip the early attach because 'launch' also attaches — the panel should be open before the build starts. The panel is the user's view, not a precondition — 'screenshot' and input actions work without it. Skip it only when the user has no interest in watching; 'launch' installs and launches an .app (it also re-attaches, but call 'attach' early rather than relying on that); 'screenshot' returns a PNG of the current screen; 'tap'/'swipe'/'text'/'button' inject input; 'press_key' presses a hardware key 'count' times: return, delete (backspace), an arrow, select_all, undo or redo (a key also hides the on-screen keyboard); 'set_appearance' switches the device to light or dark mode; 'appearance' says which it is in; 'set_keyboard' shows or hides the on-screen keyboard (it appears only while a text field has focus, and 'press_key' and 'text' hide it again); 'rotate' turns the device a quarter turn left or right ('direction'); take a 'screenshot' after it and tap in that screenshot's frame, however it comes back; 'touch_path' performs a single-finger drag along an arbitrary path (eased curves, long-press-then-drag); 'touch2_path' is the two-finger variant for pinch/rotate; 'open_url' opens a deep link; 'detach' closes the panel/stream. NOTE: a 'swipe' or 'touch_path' whose start point is on-screen and within 4pt of an edge performs the OS edge gesture instead of a plain drag — left=back, top=notification shade, bottom=home/app-switcher, right=Control Center (mapped to the current interface orientation). Start more than 4pt from the edge to drag or scroll content near the bezel.

points.description: For 'touch_path': touch path samples in device points. First point is touch-down; last is touch-up. dt_ms is the delay before that sample (0-1000 ms; the first sample's is skipped, so send 0 or omit it; at most 30 seconds in all).

points2.description: For 'touch2_path': two-finger path samples in device points. Each sample carries both contacts (x1/y1, x2/y2); first is touch-down, last is touch-up. dt_ms is the delay before that sample (0-1000 ms; the first sample's is skipped, so send 0 or omit it; at most 30 seconds in all).

key.description: For 'press_key': the key or edit command to press.

loading_messages.description: 1–4 loading messages shown to the user while the visual renders, each roughly 5 words long. Write them in the same language the user is using. Use 1 for simple visuals, more for complex ones. If the topic is serious — illness, disease, pandemics, death, grief, war, conflict, poverty, disaster, trauma, abuse, addiction, medical decisions, politically charged subjects, or anything where the reader might be personally affected — keep these BORING: describe what the code is doing in the dullest generic way, no jargon-as-drama, no evocative terms. import Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Main
open Ern.MemoryModel.Access

/-- Active fragment of RootHeldConv from WF3 ∧ I1 ∧ NoDangling (spec invariants only). -/
theorem conv_active {s : S3} (hw : WF3 s) (h1 : I1 s) (hnd : NoDangling s) :
    ∀ (x : Nat) (z : Authority) (l r : Nat), s.A[x]? = some z → z.active = true →
      z.origin = none → l ∈ z.footprint → RootPlace s.P r → partOf s.P l r →
      ∃ pr, s.P[r]? = some pr ∧ z.holder = pr.owner := by
  intro x z l r hz za zo hl hr hlr
  obtain ⟨hlP, hleaf⟩ := hw.footprints x z hz l hl
  have hlfr : l ∈ footprint s.P r := mem_footprint.2 ⟨hlP, hleaf, hlr⟩
  have hur : s.Usable r := Decidable.byContradiction fun hu => hnd x z hz za r hu l hlfr hl
  obtain ⟨i, z', pr, hz', za', zo', zm', hpr, hh', hfp'⟩ := hw.rootHeld r hr hur
  by_cases hix : i = x
  · subst hix; rw [hz] at hz'; cases hz'; exact ⟨pr, hpr, hh'⟩
  · have hancs : ∀ j w, s.A[j]? = some w → w.origin = none → s.ancs j = [] :=
      fun j w hj hw0 => by
        have : s.org j = none := by simp [S3.org, hj, hw0]
        simp [S3.ancs, chain_none this]
    have := (h1 i x z' z l hix hz' hz za' za ((hfp' l).2 hlfr) hl
      (by rw [hancs x z hz zo]; simp) (by rw [hancs i z' hz' zo']; simp)).1
    rw [zm'] at this; cases this

open Frames in
/-- exitFrame_no_dangling with the spec invariant I1 in place of the auxiliary RootHeldConv:
the proof of `Frames.exit_noDangling`, with `conv_active` for `hc`. -/
theorem exitFrame_no_dangling_I1 {k : K} {s s' : S3} (hwf : WF3 s) (h1 : I1 s)
    (hnd : NoDangling s) (h : ExitStep k s (.ok s')) :
    ∀ q, ¬ s'.Usable q → ∀ (j : Nat) (y : Authority), s'.A[j]? = some y → y.active = true →
      ∀ l ∈ footprint s'.P q, l ∉ y.footprint := by
  obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  have h3 := hpre.origins
  intro q hq j z hz za l hl hlz
  obtain ⟨y₀, hy₀, rfl⟩ := exit_get hz
  have hs := exitG_active za
  rw [(exitG_same s s.F.tail j y₀).2.1] at hlz
  have hq' : ¬ ({ s with F := s.F.tail } : S3).Usable q := fun hu => hq (exit_usable_iff.2 hu)
  by_cases hq₀ : s.Usable q
  · obtain ⟨hlP, hleaf, hlq⟩ := mem_footprint.1 hl
    obtain ⟨x0, z, r, hx0, hz, hzo, hr, hlr, hfz⟩ := hwf.rootChain j y₀ l hy₀ hlz hleaf
    have hx0o : s.org x0 = none := by simp [S3.org, hz, hzo]
    have hs0 := exit_root_survives h3 (j + 1) j (Nat.lt_succ_self j) hs x0 hx0 hx0o
    have hlz0 : l ∈ z.footprint := (hfz l).2 (mem_footprint.2 ⟨hlP, hleaf, hlr⟩)
    unfold Survives at hs0; rw [hz] at hs0
    obtain ⟨zact, hlive⟩ := hs0
    obtain ⟨pr, hpr, hh⟩ := conv_active hwf h1 hnd x0 z l r hz zact hzo hlz0 hr hlr
    rw [hh] at hlive
    obtain ⟨pl, pr', hpl, hpr', e1⟩ := hwf.ownerOf hlr
    rw [hpr] at hpr'; cases hpr'
    obtain ⟨pl', pq, hpl', hpq, e2⟩ := hwf.ownerOf hlq
    rw [hpl] at hpl'; cases hpl'
    have hdr : s.dead r = false := by
      rw [← hwf.deadOf hlr, hwf.deadOf hlq]; exact usable_dead hq₀
    have hur : ({ s with F := s.F.tail } : S3).Usable r := usable_of_owner hpr hdr hlive
    exact hq' (S3.Usable.of_same hur hpr hpq (e2.symm.trans e1)
      ((hwf.deadOf hlq).symm.trans (hwf.deadOf hlr)))
  · exact hnd j y₀ hy₀ (exitG_active' hy₀ za) q hq₀ l hl hlz

Obligations (all mandatory):
1. Machine (Part III). Relations total and deterministic; interpreters calculable with static obligations and WF as proof arguments; agreement theorems both ways on their domain; admissible-state invariants preserved; P1-P4, no double free, frame lemmas, read-after-write on every included sub-range (§16).
2. Kernel (Parts IV-XIII). Every operation exactly as written, including §63.8 and §77 local self-blocking prevention, §65 store rules (derived authority, free leaf, arrival-state exercisability), §72 parameter-origin rule, §73 reanchoring to the first surviving active origin, §69/§70 end of use and free, pinning rules. Locals created by entering a frame are owned directly by the frame; alloc creates exactly one root. Theorems: preservation of WF3 ∧ Inv3 ∧ AnchorOrderHeld ∧ NoOrphan by every step; reachable invariant from S3.init statics under DDSound; exitFrame_no_dangling; call_params_effective_protected; effective_exclusive; init_only_by_writes, init_statics, and the global induction (every Init leaf of a reached state was declared or written); correspondence between Step and Reachable.
3. Arena (Part XIV). issue_as_kernel, reset_as_kernel (both directions, same arrival state on the kernel part), newArena_as_library (no safety property depends on the guard), arena_reuse_safe, ArenaInv preserved.
4. Refinement (§82). Repr including MM-02 WF; R1, R2, R4, R6 for every kernel operation and derived arena operation; simulation with parameters fixed once per run; freeSound_derived; pinned_address_stable; exclusive_bytes. Decisions to apply: declared disjointness is disjointness of leaves (byte disjointness follows from layout well-formedness); a pointer to an empty region has address = base of the effective anchor's allocation and that allocation as provenance; a region's pointer address is the lowest address among its non-empty leaves; a leaf receiving a reference has pointer size (stated hypothesis, classed types/ABI).
5. HandlePool (contract: v0.4 annex). Composite borrow (companion derived from internal over the whole storage, entries derived from the companion); resolveMany Observe by Observe derivations, distinctness only in Modify; allocSlot/freeSlot require a live pool and Modify on the pool value; newPool requires Uninit storage; freeSlot ends the entry content with endUse effects, preconditions excluding internal and its ancestors; PoolInv = entry disjointness + pool_no_stale_access + transition guarantee that freeSlot never succeeds on an entry covered by an active companion descendant. Theorems: pool_resolve_modify_exclusive, pool_no_stale_access, stale/other-pool/atomicity/distinctness, pool_freeSlot_ends_content under the Modify right.
6. DataStack (contract below, identifier DS-v1). Marks carry stack identity and a fresh mark identifier; the stack keeps the ordered list of live marks; rewind m fails on a dead or foreign mark, rejects if an active authority derived from internal covers a cell above m, otherwise returns those cells to available and removes m and every mark above it; push and grow use the derived issue; grow is in place only (same base, extension into the space directly after the block, fail otherwise). Theorems: rewind_rejects_live_above, mark_no_aba (for every removed mark), rewind_keeps_older_marks, grow_same_base, grow_keeps_prefix_init, grow_keeps_prefix_bytes through the refinement.
7. Corpora. Encode MM2-H (first execution), MM3-H and MM23-H (replay) from the attached material, plus new cases: §63.8 and §77 self-blocking (reject, with twins), §56 guard, corrected HandlePool, DataStack (including ABA and a multi-stack frame scenario), W1-W3. import Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Ops

/-!
# Access kernel: invariants, initial state, reachability

`WF3` (§49), `I1`–`I4` (§50–§53), `NoDangling` and `NoOrphan` (§54), `Inv3` (§57), the declared
statics and `S3.init` (§47), `StaticPinnedBottom` (§75), and reachability from `S3.init statics`
under the kernel steps O1–O16 (§57). `AnchorOrder` and `AnchorOrderHeld` (§44) are in
`Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Basic`, since operations read them.
-/

namespace Ern.MemoryModel.Access

/-! ## Root places and root authorities (§40, §49) -/

/-- Root place (§40): an existing place with no structural parent. -/
def RootPlace (P : List Place) (r : Nat) : Prop := r < P.length ∧ parentOf P r = none

/-- Decidability of `RootPlace` (§40). -/
instance (P : List Place) (r : Nat) : Decidable (RootPlace P r) :=
  inferInstanceAs (Decidable (_ ∧ _))

/-- `RootChain` (§49.6): the origin chain of an authority covering a leaf ends at a root
authority (no origin) whose footprint is the footprint of a root place containing that leaf. -/
def RootChain (s : S3) : Prop :=
  ∀ (a : Nat) (y : Authority) (l : Nat), s.A[a]? = some y → l ∈ y.footprint → isLeaf s.P l →
    ∃ x z r, (x = a ∨ x ∈ s.ancs a) ∧ s.A[x]? = some z ∧ z.origin = none ∧ RootPlace s.P r ∧
      partOf s.P l r ∧ ∀ l', l' ∈ z.footprint ↔ l' ∈ footprint s.P r

/-- `RootHeld` (§49.7, §40): every usable root place has an active root authority of own mode
`Modify`, with no origin, held by the owner of the place, whose footprint is the footprint of the
place. -/
def RootHeld (s : S3) : Prop :=
  ∀ r, RootPlace s.P r → s.Usable r → ∃ (i : Nat) (z : Authority) (pr : Place),
    s.A[i]? = some z ∧ z.active = true ∧ z.origin = none ∧ z.mode = .modify ∧
    s.P[r]? = some pr ∧ z.holder = pr.owner ∧ ∀ l, l ∈ z.footprint ↔ l ∈ footprint s.P r

/-- Auxiliary converse of `RootHeld` (§40, §49.7), not a clause of `WF3`: an authority with no
origin is held by the owner of the root place of every leaf it covers. -/
def RootHeldConv (s : S3) : Prop :=

def I1 (s : S3) : Prop :=
  ∀ (a b : Nat) (x y : Authority) (p : Nat), a ≠ b → s.A[a]? = some x → s.A[b]? = some y →
    x.active = true → y.active = true → p ∈ x.footprint → p ∈ y.footprint →
    a ∉ s.ancs b → b ∉ s.ancs a → x.mode = .observe ∧ y.mode = .observe

/-- `I2` (§51): the origin of a derived authority exists; the derived mode does not exceed the
origin's and the derived footprint is within the origin's. -/
def I2 (s : S3) : Prop :=
  ∀ (b : Nat) (y : Authority) (a : Nat), s.A[b]? = some y → y.origin = some a →
    ∃ x : Authority, s.A[a]? = some x ∧ y.mode.le x.mode ∧ ∀ p ∈ y.footprint, p ∈ x.footprint

/-- `I3` (§52): every anchor of a usable place is valid (active). -/
def I3 (s : S3) : Prop := ∀ q, s.Usable q → ∀ x ∈ s.D q, s.Active x

/-- `I4` (§53, first sentence): no read of a region containing a `Moved` leaf is permitted. -/
def I4 (s : S3) : Prop := ∀ (a : Nat) (ls : List Nat) (l : Nat), l ∈ ls → s.I l = .moved →
  ¬ Read3Pre s a ls

/-- `I1 ∧ I2 ∧ I3 ∧ I4` (§57). -/
def Inv3base (s : S3) : Prop := I1 s ∧ I2 s ∧ I3 s ∧ I4 s

/-- `NoDangling` (§54): no active authority covers a leaf of an unusable place. -/
def NoDangling (s : S3) : Prop :=
  ∀ (j : Nat) (y : Authority), s.A[j]? = some y → y.active = true →
    ∀ q, ¬ s.Usable q → ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P q, l ∉ y.footprint

/-- `Inv3 = I1 ∧ I2 ∧ I3 ∧ I4 ∧ AnchorOrder ∧ NoDangling` (§57). -/
def Inv3 (s : S3) : Prop := Inv3base s ∧ AnchorOrder s ∧ NoDangling s

/-! ## `NoOrphan` (§54) -/

/-- One link of a `NoOrphan` chain (§54): `a` is active and structurally covers every leaf of the
place holding `b`. -/
def CoversHolder (s : S3) (a b : Nat) : Prop :=
  OptP (s.A[b]?) (fun z => match z.holder with
    | .place q => s.Active a ∧ ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P q, l ∈ s.afp a
    | .frame _ => False) False

/-- Consecutive elements of a list are related by `R` (§54, chains of `NoOrphan`). -/
def Linked (R : Nat → Nat → Prop) : List Nat → Prop
  | a :: b :: c => R a b ∧ Linked R (b :: c)
  | _ => True

import Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Preserve.Common

/-!
# Preservation by `endUse` (O12, §69) and `free` (O13, §70)

Both effects only make authorities inactive and mark places dead, then release the authorities
whose holder died (§69, §70 `ok` effects). The shared argument is in namespace `EndFree`; the
per-operation results state that each step preserves `KInv` (§57) and `KAux` (§40, §49.7), and
the effects of §69 and §70: the ended place stays usable, its leaves become `Uninit`, transitively
owned storage and the released unit are dead, pinned leaves block the step (§69.4, §70.4).
-/

namespace Ern.MemoryModel.Access

namespace EndFree

/-! ## Authorities that are only released (§69, §70) -/

/-- The authorities of `s₁` are those of `s`, some of them made inactive (§69, §70 `ok` effects:
authorities are released, never created or changed otherwise). -/
def OnlyReleases (s s₁ : S3) : Prop :=
  s₁.A.length = s.A.length ∧ ∀ (j : Nat) (z : Authority), s₁.A[j]? = some z →
    ∃ y, s.A[j]? = some y ∧ z.mode = y.mode ∧ z.origin = y.origin ∧ z.footprint = y.footprint ∧
      z.holder = y.holder ∧ (z.active = true → y.active = true)

/-- Mapping the authorities by a function that keeps an authority or makes it inactive only
releases authorities (§69, §70). -/
theorem map_releases {s s₁ : S3} {g : Authority → Authority} (hA : s₁.A = s.A.map g)
    (hg : ∀ y, g y = y ∨ g y = { y with active := false }) : OnlyReleases s s₁ := by
  refine ⟨by rw [hA, List.length_map], fun j z hz => ?_⟩
......

      exact not_above_self hu (.owner hplx (ho.trans hpo))

    | place hpl' _ hpo' hu =>
      rw [hplp] at hpl'; cases hpl'; rw [hpo] at hpo'; cases hpo'
      exact not_above_self hu (hcx.trans (.owner hplx (ho.trans hpo)))

/-! ## The shared preservation argument (§57, §69, §70) -/

/-- Releasing authorities and marking places dead, then releasing the authorities whose holder
died, preserves `KInv` (§57) and `KAux` (§40, §49.7), provided the death markers respect parts
(§49.2), usable places keep only valid former anchors (§52, §44), the root authorities of usable
root places are kept (§49.7), and `NoDangling` (§54) holds afterwards. -/
theorem releases_preserve {s s₁ : S3} (hk : KInv s) (ha : KAux s) (hr : OnlyReleases s s₁)
    (hP : s₁.P = s.P) (hF : s₁.F = s.F) (hn : s₁.nF = s.nF)
    (hd : ∀ q, s₁.dead q = false → s.dead q = false)
    (hparts : ∀ (q : Nat) (pl : Place) (r : Nat), s.P[q]? = some pl → pl.parent = some r →
      s₁.dead r = s₁.dead q)
    (hD : ∀ q, s₁.Usable q → ∀ x ∈ s₁.D q, x ∈ s.D q)
    (hI3 : ∀ q, s₁.Usable q → ∀ x ∈ s₁.D q, (cleanup s₁).Active x)
    (hroot : ∀ (r i : Nat) (z : Authority) (pr : Place), RootPlace s.P r → s₁.Usable r →
      s.A[i]? = some z → z.active = true → z.origin = none → s.P[r]? = some pr →
      z.holder = pr.owner → (∀ l, l ∈ z.footprint ↔ l ∈ footprint s.P r) → s₁.A[i]? = some z)
    (hnd : WF3 (cleanup s₁) → NoDangling (cleanup s₁)) :
    KInv (cleanup s₁) ∧ KAux (cleanup s₁) := by
  obtain ⟨hw, ⟨⟨i1, i2, -, -⟩, hao, -⟩, haoh, -⟩ := hk
  have hc := hr.trans (cleanup_releases s₁)
  have cP : (cleanup s₁).P = s.P := hP
  have cF : (cleanup s₁).F = s.F := hF
  have hu : ∀ q, s₁.Usable q → s.Usable q :=
    fun q h => S3.Usable.mono hP (fun f hf => hF ▸ hf) hd h
  have hU := cleanup_usable s₁
  have hw' : WF3 (cleanup s₁) :=
    { frames := by
        show s₁.F ≠ [] ∧ s₁.F.Nodup ∧ ∀ f ∈ s₁.F, f < s₁.nF
        rw [hF, hn]; exact hw.frames
      places := fun q pl r hq hp => by
        rw [cP] at hq
        obtain ⟨pr, hpr, hlt, ho, -⟩ := hw.places q pl r hq hp
        exact ⟨pr, by rw [cP]; exact hpr, hlt, ho, hparts q pl r hq hp⟩
      owners :=
        ⟨fun q pl f hq ho => by
          show f < s₁.nF
          rw [hn]; exact hw.owners.1 q pl f (by rw [← cP]; exact hq) ho,
        fun q pl o hq ho => by
          rw [cP]; exact hw.owners.2.1 q pl o (by rw [← cP]; exact hq) ho,
        fun q hq => hq.frameOf⟩
      footprints := fun a x hx l hl => by
        obtain ⟨x₀, hx₀, -, -, e, -⟩ := hc.2 a x hx
        rw [cP]; exact hw.footprints a x₀ hx₀ l (e ▸ hl)
      origins := fun b y a hb ho => by
        obtain ⟨y₀, hy₀, -, e, -⟩ := hc.2 b y hb
        exact hw.origins b y₀ a hy₀ (e ▸ ho)
      rootChain := hw.rootChain.transport (by rw [cP]) (by rw [cP]) (fun a => by rw [hc.ancs])
        (fun a y' hy' => by obtain ⟨y, hy, -, -, e, -⟩ := hc.2 a y' hy'; exact ⟨y, hy, e⟩)
        (fun x z hz hzo => by
          obtain ⟨z', hz', -, e1, e2, -⟩ := hc.get' hz
          exact ⟨z', hz', e1.trans hzo, e2⟩)
      rootHeld := fun r hrp hur => by
        rw [cP] at hrp
        have hu₁ := (hU r).1 hur
        obtain ⟨i, z, pr, hz, za, zo, zm, hpr, hh, hf⟩ := hw.rootHeld r hrp (hu r hu₁)
        have hz₁ := hroot r i z pr hrp hu₁ hz za zo hpr hh hf
        have hlive : HolderLive s₁ z.holder := by
          rw [hh]; exact owner_live hu₁ (by rw [hP]; exact hpr)
        refine ⟨i, z, pr, ?_, za, zo, zm, by rw [cP]; exact hpr, hh, by rw [cP]; exact hf⟩
        rw [cleanup_get, hz₁]; simp [hlive]
      holders := fun a y hy ya => by
        obtain ⟨-, hl⟩ := cleanup_active hy ya
        exact (HolderLive.congr (s := s₁) (s' := cleanup s₁) rfl rfl rfl _).2 hl }
  refine ⟨kInv_of hw' ⟨⟨?_, ?_, ?_, i4_always _⟩, ?_, hnd hw'⟩ ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro a b x y p hab hx hy xa ya xp yp hnab hnba
    obtain ⟨x₀, hx₀, m₁, -, f₁, -, a₁⟩ := hc.2 a x hx
    obtain ⟨y₀, hy₀, m₂, -, f₂, -, a₂⟩ := hc.2 b y hy
    rw [hc.ancs] at hnab hnba; rw [m₁, m₂]
    exact i1 a b x₀ y₀ p hab hx₀ hy₀ (a₁ xa) (a₂ ya) (f₁ ▸ xp) (f₂ ▸ yp) hnab hnba
  · intro b y a hb ho
    obtain ⟨y₀, hy₀, m₀, e, f₀, -⟩ := hc.2 b y hb
    obtain ⟨x₁, hx₁, hm, hsub⟩ := i2 b y₀ a hy₀ (e ▸ ho)
    obtain ⟨x', hx', mx, -, fx, -⟩ := hc.get' hx₁
    exact ⟨x', hx', by rw [m₀, mx]; exact hm, fun l hl => by rw [fx]; exact hsub l (f₀ ▸ hl)⟩
  · exact fun q hq x hx => hI3 q ((hU q).1 hq) x hx
  · intro q hq x hx
    have hq₁ := (hU q).1 hq
    refine (hc.effAnchorOK cP cF x _).2 ?_
    rw [S3.pframe_congr cP]
    exact hao q (hu q hq₁) x (hD q hq₁ x hx)
  · intro q hq x y' hx ya hh
    obtain ⟨y, hy, -, -, -, e, ea⟩ := hc.2 x y' hx
    refine (hc.effAnchorOK cP cF x _).2 ?_
    rw [S3.pframe_congr cP]
    exact haoh q (hu q ((hU q).1 hq)) x y hy (ea ya) (e.symm.trans hh)
  · exact RootHeldConv.transport ha cP fun x z' hx ho => by
      obtain ⟨z, hz, -, e1, e2, e3, -⟩ := hc.2 x z' hx
      exact ⟨z, hz, e1 ▸ ho, e2, e3⟩

end EndFree

open EndFree

/-! ## O12 `endUse` (§69) -/

/-- The authorities after `endUseS` (§69, `ok` effect): those held within `p` are inactive. -/
theorem EndFree.endUseS_get (s : S3) (p j : Nat) : (endUseS s p).A[j]? =
    (s.A[j]?).map fun y => if heldIn s.P p y.holder then { y with active := false } else y := by
  simp [endUseS]

/-- `endUseS` only releases authorities (§69, `ok` effect). -/
theorem EndFree.endUseS_releases (s : S3) (p : Nat) : OnlyReleases s (endUseS s p) :=
  map_releases rfl fun y => by by_cases h : heldIn s.P p y.holder <;> simp [h]

/-- A place usable after `endUseS` was usable before (§69: the effect only adds death
markers). -/
theorem EndFree.endUseS_usable {s : S3} {p q : Nat} (h : (endUseS s p).Usable q) : s.Usable q :=
  S3.Usable.mono (s := s) (s' := endUseS s p) rfl (fun _ h => h)
    (fun q h => by simp only [endUseS, Bool.or_eq_false_iff] at h; exact h.1) h

/-- An active authority after `endUse p` (§69, `ok` effect): active before, not held within `p`,
with a holder live after `endUseS`. -/
theorem EndFree.endUse_active {s : S3} {p j : Nat} {z : Authority}
    (hz : (endUseEff s p).A[j]? = some z) (za : z.active = true) :
    s.A[j]? = some z ∧ ¬ heldIn s.P p z.holder ∧ HolderLive (endUseS s p) z.holder := by
  obtain ⟨hz₁, hl⟩ := cleanup_active hz za
  rw [endUseS_get] at hz₁
  cases hy : s.A[j]? with
  | none => rw [hy] at hz₁; cases hz₁
  | some y =>
    rw [hy] at hz₁
    by_cases hh : heldIn s.P p y.holder
    · simp only [hh, Option.map_some, ↓reduceIte, Option.some.injEq] at hz₁
      subst hz₁; simp at za
    · simp only [hh, Option.map_some, ↓reduceIte, Option.some.injEq] at hz₁
      subst hz₁; exact ⟨rfl, hh, hl⟩

/-- Under `EndUsePre` (§69.3) and `I3` (§52), every anchor of a place usable after `endUseS`
stays active after `endUse`. -/
theorem EndFree.endUse_anchors {k : K} {s : S3} {p : Nat} (h3 : I3 s) (hpre : EndUsePre k s p) :
    ∀ q, (endUseS s p).Usable q → ∀ x ∈ (endUseS s p).D q, (endUseEff s p).Active x := by
  intro q hq x hx
  have hq₀ := endUseS_usable hq
  have hx₀ : x ∈ s.D q := by
    simp only [endUseS] at hx; split at hx
    · simp at hx
    · exact hx
  obtain ⟨y, hy, ya⟩ := h3 q hq₀ x hx₀
  have hc := hpre.anchors q (List.mem_range.2 hq₀.lt) hq x hx
  unfold EndUseAnchorOK OptP at hc; rw [hy] at hc
  obtain ⟨hnh, -, hl⟩ := hc
  exact ⟨y, by rw [endUseEff, cleanup_get, endUseS_get, hy]; simp [hnh, hl], ya⟩

/-- `endUse` preserves `NoDangling` (§54, §69), under `WF3` (§49) and `RootHeldConv` (§40): an
active authority on a leaf of a place that stops being usable is derived, and blocked by §69.2, or
a root, held by the owner of the root place of the leaf, which would stay usable. -/
theorem EndFree.endUse_noDangling {k : K} {s : S3} {p : Nat} (hw : WF3 s) (hnd : NoDangling s)
    (ha : RootHeldConv s) (hpre : EndUsePre k s p) (hw' : WF3 (endUseEff s p)) :
    NoDangling (endUseEff s p) := by
  have hU := cleanup_usable (endUseS s p)
  intro j z hz za q hq l hl hlz
  obtain ⟨hz₀, hnh, hlive⟩ := endUse_active hz za
  by_cases hq₀ : ¬ s.Usable q
  · exact hnd j z hz₀ za q hq₀ l hl hlz
  replace hq₀ := Decidable.of_not_not hq₀
  obtain ⟨-, hleaf, hlq⟩ := mem_footprint.1 hl
  have hl₀ : s.Usable l := usable_of_partOf hw (l + 1) l q (Nat.lt_succ_self l) hlq hq₀
  have hl₁ : ¬ (endUseS s p).Usable l := fun hu => hq (usable_of_part hw' hlq ((hU l).2 hu))
  cases hzo : z.origin with
  | some o =>
    have hacc := hpre.access j (List.mem_range.2 (lt_of_getElem? hz₀))
    unfold EndUseAccessOK OptP at hacc; rw [hz₀] at hacc
    rcases hacc za (by rw [hzo]; simp) ⟨l, hlz, .inr ⟨hleaf, hl₀, hl₁⟩⟩ with e | e
    · exact hnh e
    · exact e hlive
  | none =>
    obtain ⟨-, -, r, -, -, -, hr, hlr, -⟩ := hw.rootChain j z l hz₀ hlz hleaf
    obtain ⟨pr, hpr, hh⟩ := ha j z l r hz₀ hzo hlz hr hlr
    have hnown : ¬ OwnedIn s.P p r := fun hown => by
      cases hown with
      | @direct _ o _ hpl ho hpart =>
        have e : pr.owner = .place o := by rw [hpr] at hpl; cases hpl; exact ho
        rw [hh, e] at hnh; exact hnh hpart
      | @step _ o _ hpl ho hown' =>
        have e : pr.owner = .place o := by rw [hpr] at hpl; cases hpl; exact ho
        rw [hh, e] at hlive
        have := dead_false hlive
        simp only [endUseS, Bool.or_eq_false_iff, decide_eq_false_iff_not] at this
        exact this.2 hown'
    have hd : (endUseS s p).dead r = false := by
      simp only [endUseS, ← hw.deadOf hlr, dead_false hl₀, Bool.false_or,
        decide_eq_false_iff_not]
      exact hnown
    have hr₁ : (endUseS s p).Usable r := usable_of_owner hpr hd (hh ▸ hlive)
    exact hl₁ ((hU l).1 (usable_of_partOf hw' (l + 1) l r (Nat.lt_succ_self l) hlr ((hU r).2 hr₁)))

/-- `endUse` preserves the kernel invariant `KInv` (§57) and `KAux` (§40, §49.7) (O12, §69). -/
theorem endUse_preserves {k : K} {s s' : S3} {p : Nat} (hk : KInv s) (ha : KAux s)
    (h : EndUseStep k p s (.ok s')) : KInv s' ∧ KAux s' := by
  obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  have hw := hk.1
  refine releases_preserve hk ha (endUseS_releases s p) rfl rfl rfl
    (fun q h => by simp only [endUseS, Bool.or_eq_false_iff] at h; exact h.1)
    (fun q pl r hq hp => ?_) (fun q _ x hx => ?_) (endUse_anchors hk.2.1.1.2.2.1 hpre)
    (fun r i z pr _ hur hz _ _ hpr hzh _ => ?_)
    (endUse_noDangling hw hk.2.1.2.2 ha hpre)
  · obtain ⟨-, -, -, -, hd⟩ := hw.places q pl r hq hp
    simp only [endUseS, hd, decide_eq_decide.2 (ownedIn_parent hw hq hp)]
  · simp only [endUseS] at hx; split at hx
    · simp at hx
    · exact hx
  · have hnh : ¬ heldIn s.P p z.holder := fun hh => by
      have hd := dead_false hur
      simp only [endUseS, Bool.or_eq_false_iff, decide_eq_false_iff_not] at hd
      rw [hzh] at hh
      cases ho : pr.owner with
      | frame f => rw [ho] at hh; exact hh
      | place o => rw [ho] at hh; exact hd.2 (.direct hpr ho hh)
    rw [endUseS_get, hz]; simp [hnh]

/-- `endUse` keeps the anchors of every usable place that is not a part of the ended value, and
they are valid (§69 `ok` effect, §52), under `KInv` (§57) and `KAux`. -/
theorem endUse_keeps_dependents {k : K} {s s' : S3} {p : Nat} (hk : KInv s) (ha : KAux s)
    (h : EndUseStep k p s (.ok s')) :
    ∀ q, s'.Usable q → ¬ partOf s.P q p → s'.D q = s.D q ∧ ∀ x ∈ s'.D q, s'.Active x := by
  have hi3 := (endUse_preserves hk ha h).1.2.1.1.2.2.1
  obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  intro q hq hnp
  exact ⟨by simp [endUseEff, cleanup, endUseS, hnp], hi3 q hq⟩

/-- After `endUse p` the place `p` remains usable (§69 `ok` effect), under `KInv` (§57). -/
theorem endUse_place_usable {k : K} {s s' : S3} {p : Nat} (hk : KInv s)
    (h : EndUseStep k p s (.ok s')) : s'.Usable p := by
  obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  have hw := hk.1
  have hp := hpre.usable

/-- A root static is a root place of the initial state (§40, §47). -/
private theorem init_rootPlace {statics : Statics} {j i : Nat}
    (h : (rootIdx (statics.map (·.1)))[j]? = some i) : RootPlace (S3.init statics).P i := by
  obtain ⟨hil, hin⟩ := rootIdx_get h
  have hi : i < statics.length := by simpa using hil
  exact ⟨by rw [initP_len]; exact hi,
    by simp only [parentOf, initP_get hi, Option.bind_some]; exact hin⟩

/-- Root authorities of distinct positions are roots of distinct statics (§47: one root authority
per root static). -/
private theorem init_root_inj {statics : Statics} {j j' i : Nat}
    (h : (rootIdx (statics.map (·.1)))[j]? = some i)
    (h' : (rootIdx (statics.map (·.1)))[j']? = some i) : j = j' :=
  Frames.getElem?_inj_of_lt ((Frames.range_pairwise_lt _).filter _) h h'

/-- The initial state satisfies `KInv` (§57), `KAux` (§40, §49.7) and `HeldAnchored` (auxiliary)
for a well-formed statics declaration (§47; `StaticsOK` is a hypothesis, not stated by §47). -/
theorem init_kinv {statics : Statics} (hst : StaticsOK statics) :
    KInv (S3.init statics) ∧ KAux (S3.init statics) ∧ HeldAnchored (S3.init statics) := by
  have hus : ∀ i, i < statics.length → (S3.init statics).Usable i :=
    fun i hi => init_usable hst (i + 1) i (Nat.lt_succ_self _) hi
  have hof : ∀ (q : Nat) (pl : Place) (f : Nat), (S3.init statics).P[q]? = some pl →
      pl.owner = .frame f → f < (S3.init statics).nF := by
    intro q pl f hq ho
    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := initP_get' hq
    simp only [shapeOwner] at ho
    split at ho
    · cases ho
    · cases ho; exact Nat.zero_lt_one
  have hop : ∀ (q : Nat) (pl : Place) (o : Nat), (S3.init statics).P[q]? = some pl →
      pl.owner = .place o → o < (S3.init statics).P.length := by
    intro q pl o hq ho
    obtain ⟨hql, rfl⟩ := initP_get' hq
    simp only [shapeOwner] at ho
    split at ho
    · rename_i o' ho'
      cases ho
      rw [initP_len]; exact Nat.lt_trans (statics_owner hst hql ho') hql
    · cases ho
  have hw : WF3 (S3.init statics) := {
    frames := ⟨by simp [S3.init], by simp [S3.init], by simp [S3.init]⟩
    places := fun q pl r hq hp => by
      obtain ⟨hql, rfl⟩ := initP_get' hq
      obtain ⟨hrq, hown⟩ := statics_parent hst hql hp
      exact ⟨_, initP_get (by omega), hrq, by simp only [shapeOwner, hown], rfl⟩
    owners := ⟨hof, hop, fun _ hq => hq.frameOf⟩
    footprints := fun a x ha l hl => by
      obtain ⟨i, -, rfl⟩ := initA_get ha
      exact ⟨(mem_footprint.1 hl).1, (mem_footprint.1 hl).2.1⟩
    origins := fun b y a hb ho => by
      obtain ⟨i, -, rfl⟩ := initA_get hb; cases ho
    rootChain := fun a y l ha hl _ => by
      obtain ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩ := initA_get ha
      exact ⟨a, _, i, .inl rfl, ha, rfl, init_rootPlace hi, (mem_footprint.1 hl).2.2,
        fun _ => Iff.rfl⟩
    rootHeld := fun r hr _ => by
      have hrl : r < statics.length := by have := hr.1; rwa [initP_len] at this
      have hpn : ((statics.map (·.1))[r]?).bind (·.1) = none := by
        have := hr.2; simp only [parentOf, initP_get hrl, Option.bind_some] at this; exact this
      have hmem : r ∈ rootIdx (statics.map (·.1)) := by
        simp only [rootIdx, List.mem_filter, List.mem_range, List.length_map, hrl, hpn,
          Option.isNone_none, and_self]
      obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := Frames.exists_getElem?_of_mem hmem
      refine ⟨j, ⟨.modify, none, footprint (S3.init statics).P r,
        shapeOwner (statics.map (·.1)) (.frame 0) r, true⟩, _, ?_, rfl, rfl, rfl, initP_get hrl,
        rfl, fun _ => Iff.rfl⟩
      simp only [S3.init, List.getElem?_map, hj]; rfl
    holders := fun a y ha _ => by
      obtain ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩ := initA_get ha
      have hil : i < statics.length := by simpa using (rootIdx_get hi).1
      show HolderLive _ (shapeOwner (statics.map (·.1)) (.frame 0) i)
      unfold shapeOwner
      cases ho : ((statics.map (·.1))[i]?).bind (·.2.1) with
      | none => exact List.mem_singleton_self _
      | some o => exact hus o (Nat.lt_trans (statics_owner hst hil ho) hil) }
  have hconv : RootHeldConv (S3.init statics) := fun x z l r hx _ hl hrp hlr => by
    obtain ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩ := initA_get hx
    obtain rfl := rootOf_unique hrp (init_rootPlace hi) hlr (mem_footprint.1 hl).2.2
    have hil : r < statics.length := by simpa using (rootIdx_get hi).1
    exact ⟨_, initP_get hil, rfl⟩
  have hi1 : I1 (S3.init statics) := fun a b x y p hab ha hb _ _ xp yp _ _ => by
    obtain ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩ := initA_get ha
    obtain ⟨i', hi', rfl⟩ := initA_get hb
    have hii : i ≠ i' := fun e => hab (init_root_inj hi (e ▸ hi'))
    exact absurd (rootOf_unique (init_rootPlace hi) (init_rootPlace hi') (mem_footprint.1 xp).2.2
      (mem_footprint.1 yp).2.2) hii
  have hnd : NoDangling (S3.init statics) := fun _ _ _ _ q hq l hl _ =>
    hq (hus q (init_lt_of_mem_footprint hl))
  have haoh : AnchorOrderHeld (S3.init statics) := fun q hq x y hy _ hhq => by
    obtain ⟨i, -, rfl⟩ := initA_get hy
    have hex : (S3.init statics).effAnchor x = x := by
      have : (S3.init statics).org x = none := by simp [S3.org, hy]
      simp [S3.effAnchor, S3.ancs, chain_none this]
    obtain ⟨f, hf, hfF⟩ := hq.frameOf
    have hf0 : f = 0 := List.mem_singleton.1 hfF
    subst hf0
    have hhq' : shapeOwner (statics.map (·.1)) (.frame 0) i = .place q := hhq
    unfold EffAnchorOK
    rw [hex, hy]
    simp only [OptP, hhq', S3.hframe, pframe_iff.2 hf]
    exact hfF
  refine ⟨kInv_of hw ⟨⟨hi1, ?_, fun _ _ x hx => ?_, i4_always _⟩, fun _ _ x hx => ?_, hnd⟩ haoh,
    hconv, fun x y q hy _ ho _ _ => ?_⟩
  · intro b y a hb ho
    obtain ⟨i, -, rfl⟩ := initA_get hb; cases ho
  · cases hx
  · cases hx
  · obtain ⟨i, -, rfl⟩ := initA_get hy; exact absurd rfl ho

/-- The `Init` leaves of the initial state are exactly the statics declared `Init` (§47, §59). -/
theorem init_statics (statics : Statics) (l : Nat) :
    (S3.init statics).I l = .init ↔ ∃ e, statics[l]? = some e ∧ e.2 = true := by
  show (if ((statics[l]?).map (·.2)).getD false then InitSt.init else .uninit) = .init ↔ _
  cases statics[l]? with
  | none => simp
  | some e => cases he : e.2 <;> simp [he]

/-! ## Reachable states (§57) -/

/-- §57 as stated is false: under a contract satisfying `DDSound` (§80) and well-formed statics
(§47), a reachable state violates `KInv`, after an accepted `transfer` (§63,
`transfer_breaks_kinv`). -/
theorem reachable_kinv_false : ¬ ∀ (k : K) (statics : Statics) (s : S3), DDSound k →
    StaticsOK statics → Reachable k statics s → KInv s := by
  intro hall
  obtain ⟨hdd, s, s', hr, -, -, ht, hn⟩ := transfer_breaks_kinv
  exact hn (hall _ _ _ hdd (by decide) (.step hr (.transfer ht)))

/-- A kernel step whose `transfer`, if it is one, leaves its destination usable (§63). The
condition is a hypothesis on runs, not a clause of §63 nor of §57. -/
def KStepDU (k : K) (s s' : S3) : Prop :=
  ∃ op : KernelOp, op.Step k s (.ok s') ∧ ∀ src dst, op = .transfer src dst → s'.Usable dst

/-- States reached from `S3.init statics` by runs whose transfers keep the destination usable
(§57, restricted by the hypothesis of `KStepDU`, which is not a clause of §63). -/
inductive ReachableDU (k : K) (statics : Statics) : S3 → Prop where
  /-- The initial state (§47). -/
  | init : ReachableDU k statics (S3.init statics)
  /-- One more step of `KStepDU` (§57). -/
  | step {s s' : S3} : ReachableDU k statics s → KStepDU k s s' → ReachableDU k statics s'

/-- From a state satisfying `KInv` (§57), `KAux` (§40, §49.7) and `HeldAnchored` under
`DDSound` (§80), the steps of `KStepDU` are exactly the kernel steps whose resulting state
satisfies `KInv`: the restriction of `ReachableDU` keeps exactly the runs along which §57
holds. -/
theorem kstepDU_iff {k : K} {s s' : S3} (hdd : DDSound k) (hinv : KInv s) (haux : KAux s)
    (hheld : HeldAnchored s) : KStepDU k s s' ↔ KStep k s s' ∧ KInv s' := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨op, hop, hdu⟩
    exact ⟨kstep_iff.2 ⟨op, hop⟩, (op_preserves_of_dst_usable hdd hinv haux hheld hop hdu).1⟩
  · rintro ⟨h, hk⟩
    obtain ⟨op, hop⟩ := kstep_iff.1 h
    refine ⟨op, hop, fun src dst e => ?_⟩
    subst e
    exact transfer_dst_usable_of_noDangling hinv.1 hop hk.2.1.2.2

/-- A state of `ReachableDU` is reachable (§57). -/
theorem ReachableDU.reachable {k : K} {statics : Statics} {s : S3}
    (h : ReachableDU k statics s) : Reachable k statics s := by
  induction h with
  | init => exact .init
  | step _ h ih =>
    obtain ⟨op, hop, -⟩ := h
    exact .step ih (kstep_iff.2 ⟨op, hop⟩)

/-- The main invariant of §57 (`WF3 ∧ Inv3 ∧ AnchorOrderHeld ∧ NoOrphan`, with `KAux` and
`HeldAnchored`) on the states reached by runs whose transfers keep the destination usable, under
`DDSound` (§80) and well-formed statics (`StaticsOK`, a hypothesis not stated by §47). The
restriction of the runs is not a clause of §63: without it the statement is false
(`reachable_kinv_false`). -/
theorem reachableDU_kinv {k : K} {statics : Statics} {s : S3} (hdd : DDSound k)
    (hst : StaticsOK statics) (h : ReachableDU k statics s) :
    KInv s ∧ KAux s ∧ HeldAnchored s := by
  induction h with
  | init => exact init_kinv hst
  | step _ h ih =>
    obtain ⟨op, hop, hdu⟩ := h
    exact op_preserves_of_dst_usable hdd ih.1 ih.2.1 ih.2.2 hop hdu

/-! ## Initialization history (§59) -/

/-- Operation `op` writes leaf `l` from state `s` (§59): `write3` or `writeShared` of a list
containing `l`, `store` into `l`, or a `transfer` of which `l` is a destination leaf
corresponding to a source leaf `Init` before the step. -/
def KernelOp.Writes (s : S3) (l : Nat) : KernelOp → Prop
  | .write _ ls => l ∈ ls
  | .writeShared _ ls => l ∈ ls
  | .store _ p => l = p
  | .transfer src dst => l ∈ footprint s.P dst ∧
      ∃ l' ∈ footprint s.P src, corr s.P src dst l' = some l ∧ s.I l' = .init
  | _ => False

/-- In every `ok` step, a leaf that becomes `Init` is written by the step (§59): a permitted write
(`write3`, `writeShared`, `store`) or a transfer from a corresponding source leaf already
`Init`. -/
theorem init_only_by_writes {k : K} {op : KernelOp} {s s' : S3} {l : Nat}
    (h : op.Step k s (.ok s')) (hl : s.I l ≠ .init) (hl' : s'.I l = .init) : op.Writes s l := by
  cases op with
  | derive => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h; exact absurd hl' hl
  | split => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h; exact absurd hl' hl
  | release a =>
    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
    unfold releaseEff at hl'; split at hl' <;> exact absurd hl' hl
  | transfer src dst =>
    obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
    have e : (transferEff s src dst).I l = if l ∈ footprint s.P dst then .init
        else if l ∈ footprint s.P src then .moved else s.I l := rfl
    rw [e] at hl'
    split at hl'
    · rename_i hld
      obtain ⟨hlP, hleaf, hlp⟩ := mem_footprint.1 hld
      obtain ⟨r, hr, hrs, hc⟩ := hpre.sameShape.2 l (List.mem_range.2 hlP) hlp
      have h1 := hpre.sameShape.1 r hr hrs
      rw [hc] at h1
      have hkr : kids s.P r = [] := by
        have : (kids s.P l).length = 0 := by rw [kids_nil_iff.2 hleaf]; rfl
        exact List.eq_nil_of_length_eq_zero (by simp only [OptP] at h1; omega)
      have hrf : r ∈ footprint s.P src :=
        mem_footprint.2 ⟨List.mem_range.1 hr, kids_nil_iff.1 hkr, hrs⟩
      exact ⟨hld, r, hrf, hc, hpre.srcInit r hrf⟩
    · split at hl'
      · cases hl'
      · exact absurd hl' hl
  | depend => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h; exact absurd hl' hl
  | enter ps ls =>
    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
    have e : (enterEff s ps ls).I l = if s.P.length ≤ l then .uninit else s.I l := rfl
    rw [e] at hl'; split at hl'
    · cases hl'
    · exact absurd hl' hl
  | exit => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h; exact absurd hl' hl
  | read => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h; exact absurd hl' hl
  | write a ls =>
    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
    have e : (write3Eff s ls).I l = if l ∈ ls then .init else s.I l := rfl
    rw [e] at hl'; split at hl'
    · assumption
    · exact absurd hl' hl
  | writeShared a ls =>
    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
    have e : (write3Eff s ls).I l = if l ∈ ls then .init else s.I l := rfl
    rw [e] at hl'; split at hl'
    · assumption
    · exact absurd hl' hl
  | pin => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h; exact absurd hl' hl
  | unpin => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h; exact absurd hl' hl
  | endUse p =>
    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
    have e : (endUseEff s p).I l = if l ∈ footprint s.P p then .uninit else s.I l := rfl
    rw [e] at hl'; split at hl'
    · cases hl'
    · exact absurd hl' hl
  | free => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h; exact absurd hl' hl
  | alloc pr ow ls =>
    cases h with
    | ok _ _ =>
      have e : (allocEff s ow ls).I l = if s.P.length ≤ l then .uninit else s.I l := rfl
      rw [e] at hl'; split at hl'
      · cases hl'
      · exact absurd hl' hl
  | store a p =>
    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
    show l = p
    refine Decidable.byContradiction fun ne => hl ?_
    unfold storeEff at hl'
    split at hl'
    · simpa [ne] using hl'
    · exact hl'

/-- Every `Init` leaf of a state reached by a run from `S3.init statics` was declared `Init`
(§47) or was made `Init` by a write step of that run (§59): a step `t → t'` of the run, through
an operation writing the leaf, after which the run continues from `t'` to the final state. -/
theorem init_history {k : K} {statics : Statics} {s : S3} {l : Nat}
    (h : KStar k (S3.init statics) s) (hl : s.I l = .init) :
    (∃ e, statics[l]? = some e ∧ e.2 = true) ∨
      ∃ (t t' : S3) (op : KernelOp), KStar k (S3.init statics) t ∧ op.Step k t (.ok t') ∧
        t.I l ≠ .init ∧ t'.I l = .init ∧ op.Writes t l ∧ KStar k t' s := by
  induction h with
  | refl => exact .inl ((init_statics statics l).1 hl)
  | tail ht hst ih =>
    rename_i t u
    by_cases htl : t.I l = .init
    · rcases ih htl with hd | ⟨t₀, t₀', op, h₀, hs₀, hn₀, hi₀, hw₀, h₀'⟩
      · exact .inl hd
      · exact .inr ⟨t₀, t₀', op, h₀, hs₀, hn₀, hi₀, hw₀, .tail h₀' hst⟩
    · obtain ⟨op, hop⟩ := kstep_iff.1 hst
      exact .inr ⟨t, u, op, ht, hop, htl, hl, init_only_by_writes hop htl hl, .refl⟩

# Access kernel: steps, reachable states and the main invariant

Assembles the per-operation results of `Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Preserve.*` into the statements of
§57, §58 and §59 of `specs/ERN_Memory_Model_Specification_v0.md`:

* kernel operations O1–O16 as data, their outcome relation, and the correspondence of `KStep` and
  `Reachable` with the labelled steps and their reflexive-transitive closure (§57, §58);
* preservation of `KInv` (§57) and `KAux` by every step except `transfer` (§63), and for
  `transfer` the exact condition: on states satisfying the auxiliary `HeldAnchored`, the step
  preserves the invariant iff the destination is usable afterwards;
* `HeldAnchored` holds initially and is preserved by every step from a `WF3` state;
* the initial state satisfies the invariant under `StaticsOK` (§47), and its `Init` leaves are the
  declared ones;
* the main invariant on reachable states (§57) is false as stated (`reachable_kinv_false`); it
  holds on runs whose transfers keep the destination usable (`reachableDU_kinv`);
* §59: only writes and transfers make a leaf `Init`, and every `Init` leaf of a reached state was
  declared or written on the run; §39: frame 0 stays at the bottom of the stack; §58: only `alloc`
  fails.
-/

namespace Ern.MemoryModel.Access

/-! ## Kernel operations as data (§58, §60–§75) -/

/-- A kernel operation O1–O16 with its arguments (§60–§75). -/
inductive KernelOp where
  /-- O1 `derive` (§60). -/
  | derive (src : Nat) (region : List Nat) (m : Mode)
  /-- O2 `split` (§61). -/
  | split (src : Nat) (rs : List (List Nat))
  /-- O3 `release` (§62). -/

/-- The base frame 0 is never removed from the stack of a reachable state (§39). -/
theorem reachable_base_mem {k : K} {statics : Statics} {s : S3} (h : Reachable k statics s) :
    0 ∈ s.F :=
  List.mem_of_getLast? (reachable_base h)

/-! ## Preservation by every step except `transfer` (§57, §58) -/

/-- Every operation other than `transfer` preserves `KInv` (§57) and `KAux` (§40, §49.7) from its
`ok` outcome, under `DDSound` (§80, used by `split`, §61). -/
theorem op_preserves {k : K} {op : KernelOp} {s s' : S3} (hdd : DDSound k) (hinv : KInv s)
    (haux : KAux s) (h : op.Step k s (.ok s')) (hnt : ∀ src dst, op ≠ .transfer src dst) :
    KInv s' ∧ KAux s' := by
  cases op with
  | derive => exact derive_preserves hinv haux h
  | split => exact split_preserves hdd hinv haux h
  | release => exact release_preserves hinv haux h
  | transfer src dst => exact absurd rfl (hnt src dst)
  | depend => exact depend_preserves hinv haux h
  | enter => exact enter_preserves hinv haux h
  | exit => exact exit_preserves hinv haux h
  | read => exact read_preserves hinv haux h
  | write => exact write_preserves hinv haux h
  | writeShared => exact writeShared_preserves hinv haux h
  | pin => exact pin_preserves hinv haux h
  | unpin => exact unpin_preserves hinv haux h
  | endUse => exact endUse_preserves hinv haux h
  | free => exact free_preserves hinv haux h
  | alloc => exact alloc_preserves hinv haux h
  | store => exact store_preserves hinv haux h

/-- Every kernel step from a state satisfying `KInv` (§57) and `KAux` (§40, §49.7) under `DDSound`
(§80) either preserves both or is an accepted `transfer` (§63), the one exception
(`transfer_breaks_kinv`). -/
theorem kstep_preserves {k : K} {s s' : S3} (hdd : DDSound k) (hinv : KInv s) (haux : KAux s)
    (h : KStep k s s') :
    (KInv s' ∧ KAux s') ∨ ∃ src dst, TransferStep k src dst s (.ok s') := by
  obtain ⟨op, hop⟩ := kstep_iff.1 h
  cases op with
  | transfer src dst => exact .inr ⟨src, dst, hop⟩
  | _ => exact .inl (op_preserves hdd hinv haux hop fun _ _ e => KernelOp.noConfusion e)

/-! ## `HeldAnchored` is preserved by every step (§44, §65, §63) -/

/-- An active derived authority of the resulting state held by place `q` is an anchor of `q`
(§44), or it was already such an authority before the step and the step keeps the anchors of `q`
when `q` was usable (§52). Under `WF3` (§49.8) this gives `HeldAnchored` after the step. -/

/-- `HeldAnchored` is preserved by every kernel step from a `WF3` state (§44, §49, §57). -/
theorem kstep_preserves_heldAnchored {k : K} {s s' : S3} (hw : WF3 s) (hh : HeldAnchored s)
    (h : KStep k s s') : HeldAnchored s' := by
  obtain ⟨op, hop⟩ := kstep_iff.1 h
  exact op_preserves_heldAnchored hw hh hop

/-! ## The transfer step (§63, §57) -/

/-- After an accepted `transfer` (§63) from a `WF3` state (§49), `NoDangling` (§54) of the
resulting state forces the destination to be usable: an authority of the current frame with
`Modify` over the destination (§63.1) still covers its leaves. -/
theorem transfer_dst_usable_of_noDangling {k : K} {s s' : S3} {src dst : Nat} (hw : WF3 s)
    (h : TransferStep k src dst s (.ok s')) (hnd : NoDangling s') : s'.Usable dst := by
  obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  refine Decidable.byContradiction fun hu => ?_
  obtain ⟨a, -, -, hall⟩ := hpre.dstRight
  obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ := exists_mem_footprint hw (s.P.length - dst + 1) dst (by omega)
    hpre.dstUsable.lt
  have hal := hall l hl
  cases he : effective s a l with
  | none => rw [he] at hal; exact hal
  | some e =>
    obtain ⟨x, hx, xa, hlx, -⟩ := effective_some he
    have hx' : (transferEff s src dst).A[a]? = some (if heldIn s.P src x.holder then
        { x with holder := mvTo s.P src dst x.holder } else x) := by
      rw [transfer_A_get, hx]; rfl
    exact hnd a _ hx' (by split <;> exact xa) dst hu l (by rw [transfer_footprint]; exact hl)
      (by split <;> exact hlx)

/-- On a state satisfying `KInv` (§57), `KAux` (§40, §49.7) and `HeldAnchored` (auxiliary, not a
clause of §63 nor of §57), an accepted `transfer` (§63) preserves `KInv ∧ KAux` iff its
destination is usable in the resulting state. The destination usable afterwards is not a clause of
§63 (`transfer_breaks_kinv`); this states exactly when §57 holds after the step. -/
theorem transfer_kinv_iff {k : K} {s s' : S3} {src dst : Nat} (hinv : KInv s) (haux : KAux s)
    (hheld : HeldAnchored s) (h : TransferStep k src dst s (.ok s')) :
    KInv s' ∧ KAux s' ↔ s'.Usable dst :=
  ⟨fun hk => transfer_dst_usable_of_noDangling hinv.1 h hk.1.2.1.2.2,
    transfer_preserves_of_dst_usable_of_heldAnchored hinv haux hheld h⟩

/-- Every operation, `transfer` included when its destination stays usable (a hypothesis, not a
clause of §63), preserves `KInv` (§57), `KAux` (§40, §49.7) and `HeldAnchored` (auxiliary) under
`DDSound` (§80). -/
theorem op_preserves_of_dst_usable {k : K} {op : KernelOp} {s s' : S3} (hdd : DDSound k)
    (hinv : KInv s) (haux : KAux s) (hheld : HeldAnchored s) (h : op.Step k s (.ok s'))
    (hdu : ∀ src dst, op = .transfer src dst → s'.Usable dst) :
    KInv s' ∧ KAux s' ∧ HeldAnchored s' := by
  have hh' := op_preserves_heldAnchored hinv.1 hheld h
  cases op with
  | transfer src dst =>
    have h' := (transfer_kinv_iff hinv haux hheld h).2 (hdu src dst rfl)
    exact ⟨h'.1, h'.2, hh'⟩
  | _ =>
    have h' := op_preserves hdd hinv haux h fun _ _ e => KernelOp.noConfusion e
    exact ⟨h'.1, h'.2, hh'⟩

/-! ## The initial state (§47) -/

/-- The places of `S3.init statics` are the declared statics (§47). -/
private theorem initP_len (statics : Statics) : (S3.init statics).P.length = statics.length := by
  simp [S3.init, shapeP]

/-- The place of a static (§47): its declared parent, its owner (the owning static or frame 0),
its kind. -/
private theorem initP_get {statics : Statics} {i : Nat} (hi : i < statics.length) :
    (S3.init statics).P[i]? = some ⟨((statics.map (·.1))[i]?).bind (·.1),
      shapeOwner (statics.map (·.1)) (.frame 0) i,
      (((statics.map (·.1))[i]?).map (·.2.2)).getD 0⟩ := by

import Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Preserve.Common

/-!
# Access kernel: `transfer` (O4, §63)

Properties of `transfer` (§63) and its preservation of the kernel invariant `KInv` (§57) with
`KAux`.

* §63 as written does not preserve `KInv`: `transfer_breaks_kinv` is a reachable state where an
  accepted transfer closes an ownership cycle, breaking holder validity (§49.8) and `NoDangling`
  (§54).
* With the destination usable in the resulting state (an extra hypothesis, not a clause of §63),
  `WF3`, `Inv3`, `NoOrphan` and `KAux` are preserved (`transfer_preserves_wf3_inv3_of_dst_usable`),
  but `AnchorOrderHeld` is not: §63.7 constrains only the moved held authorities, and an authority
  held outside the value whose effective anchor moves with it escapes the check
  (`transfer_preserves_of_dst_usable_fails`, on a state that is not built by kernel steps).
  With the further hypothesis `HeldAnchored` (also not a clause of the spec), `KInv` and `KAux`
  are preserved (`transfer_preserves_of_dst_usable_of_heldAnchored`).
* The effect and rejection theorems of §63.
-/

namespace Ern.MemoryModel.Access

/-! ## Helpers on options and stacks -/

/-- Reading `OptP` with default `True` on a present value (§38). -/
private theorem optP_true {α : Type} {o : Option α} {P : α → Prop} {y : α} (h : OptP o P True)
    (hy : o = some y) : P y := by
  subst hy; exact h

/-- `KAux` (`RootHeldConv`, §40, §49.7) after a transfer: the holder of a root authority and the
owner of its root place change together (§63 `ok` effect, third item). -/
private theorem transfer_rootHeldConv {s : S3} {src dst : Nat} (hr : RootHeldConv s) :
    RootHeldConv (transferEff s src dst) := by
  intro x z' l r hx ho hl hrp hlr
  rw [transfer_A_get] at hx
  obtain ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩ := Option.map_eq_some_iff.1 hx

  have hl' : l ∈ z.footprint := by split at hl <;> exact hl
  have hrp' : RootPlace s.P r := by
    simpa only [RootPlace, transfer_len, transfer_parentOf] using hrp
  have hlr' : partOf s.P l r := (transfer_partOf s src dst l r).1 hlr

  refine ⟨_, by rw [transfer_P_get, hpr]; rfl, ?_⟩
  by_cases hc : heldIn s.P src pr.owner <;> simp [hc, hh]

/-- `WF3` (§49) after an accepted transfer whose destination is usable in the resulting state.
Only §49.8 (holder validity) uses the destination's usability. -/
private theorem transfer_wf3 {k : K} {s : S3} {src dst : Nat} (hwf : WF3 s)
    (hpre : TransferPre k s src dst) (hd' : (transferEff s src dst).Usable dst) :
    WF3 (transferEff s src dst) := by
  have sk := transfer_skel s src dst
....

      · obtain ⟨r, hr, -, hxr⟩ := mem_movedTo.1 hx

    obtain ⟨y₀, hy₀, rfl⟩ := Option.map_eq_some_iff.1 hy

/-- With the destination usable in the resulting state, an accepted transfer preserves `WF3`,
`Inv3`, `NoOrphan` (§57) and `KAux` (§40, §49.7). The hypothesis `hd'` is not a clause of §63:
`transfer_breaks_kinv` shows that §63 does not imply it. -/
theorem transfer_preserves_wf3_inv3_of_dst_usable {k : K} {s s' : S3} {src dst : Nat}
    (hinv : KInv s) (haux : KAux s) (h : TransferStep k src dst s (.ok s'))
    (hd' : s'.Usable dst) : WF3 s' ∧ Inv3 s' ∧ NoOrphan s' ∧ KAux s' := by
  obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  have hw' := transfer_wf3 hinv.1 hpre hd'
  exact ⟨hw', transfer_inv3 hinv.1 hinv.2.1 hpre hd', noOrphan_of_wf3 hw',
    transfer_rootHeldConv haux⟩

/-- Auxiliary hypothesis, not a clause of §63 nor of the invariant of §57: every active derived
authority held by a usable place is among the anchors of that place (§44). `store` (§65) adds
the stored authority to the anchors of its target, and the `ok` effect of §63 moves an
authority held by a part `r` of the source together with the anchors of `r`. -/
def HeldAnchored (s : S3) : Prop :=
  ∀ (x : Nat) (y : Authority) (q : Nat), s.A[x]? = some y → y.active = true → y.origin ≠ none →
    y.holder = .place q → s.Usable q → x ∈ s.D q

/-- `AnchorOrderHeld` (§44, §54) after an accepted transfer, under `HeldAnchored`: a moved held
authority is checked by §63.7; an unmoved derived one is an anchor of its unmoved holder,
checked by `AnchorOrder` in the resulting state (§63.6); an unmoved root authority is its own
effective anchor, held by the place. -/
private theorem transfer_anchorOrderHeld {k : K} {s : S3} {src dst : Nat} (hwf : WF3 s)
    (hheld : HeldAnchored s) (hpre : TransferPre k s src dst) :
    AnchorOrderHeld (transferEff s src dst) := by
  intro q hq x y hy ya hh
  have hy' := hy
  rw [transfer_A_get] at hy
  obtain ⟨y₀, hy₀, rfl⟩ := Option.map_eq_some_iff.1 hy
  by_cases hm : AnchorMoves s src x
  · have e := hpre.anchorOrderHeld x (List.mem_range.2 (lt_of_getElem? hy₀)) hm q
      (List.mem_range.2 (by rw [← transfer_len s src dst]; exact hq.lt)) hq
    rw [hy'] at e
    exact e ya hh
  · have hmv : ¬ HolderMoves s src y₀.holder := by
      unfold AnchorMoves at hm; rw [hy₀] at hm; exact hm
    have hnh : ¬ heldIn s.P src y₀.holder := by
      cases e : y₀.holder with
      | frame g => simp [heldIn]
      | place p => rw [e] at hmv; exact fun h => hmv (.inl h)
    simp only [hnh, ↓reduceIte] at ya hh hy'
    have hqs : ¬ partOf s.P q src := by rw [hh] at hmv; exact fun h => hmv (.inl h)
    cases ho : y₀.origin with
    | none =>
      have hex : (transferEff s src dst).effAnchor x = x := by
        have : (transferEff s src dst).org x = none := by simp [S3.org, hy', ho]
        simp [S3.effAnchor, S3.ancs, chain_none this]
      obtain ⟨f, hf, hfF⟩ := hq.frameOf
      unfold EffAnchorOK
      rw [hex, hy', pframe_iff.2 hf]
      simp only [OptP, hh, S3.hframe, pframe_iff.2 hf]
      exact ancestor_self hfF
    | some o =>
      have hxq := hheld x y₀ q hy₀ ya (by rw [ho]; exact fun h => by cases h) hh
        (transfer_usable_back hwf hpre.srcUsable hq)
      have hxq' : x ∈ (transferEff s src dst).D q := by
        rw [transfer_D]; simp only [hqs, ↓reduceIte]; exact List.mem_append_left _ hxq
      exact hpre.anchorOrder q hq x hxq'

/-- An accepted transfer preserves `HeldAnchored` (§44; §63 `ok` effect, second and fourth items):
an authority held by a part `r` of the source moves to `corr(r)` together with the anchors of
`r`; the other holders and their anchors are unchanged. -/
theorem transfer_preserves_heldAnchored {k : K} {s s' : S3} {src dst : Nat} (hwf : WF3 s)
    (hheld : HeldAnchored s) (h : TransferStep k src dst s (.ok s')) : HeldAnchored s' := by
  obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  intro x y q hy ya ho hh hq
  rw [transfer_A_get] at hy
  obtain ⟨y₀, hy₀, rfl⟩ := Option.map_eq_some_iff.1 hy
  have ya₀ : y₀.active = true := by split at ya <;> exact ya
  have ho₀ : y₀.origin ≠ none := by split at ho <;> exact ho
  by_cases hc : heldIn s.P src y₀.holder
  · simp only [hc, ↓reduceIte] at hh
    cases e : y₀.holder with
    | frame _ => rw [e] at hc; exact hc.elim
    | place r =>
      rw [e] at hc hh
      obtain ⟨r', hcr, -⟩ :=
        optP_false_iff.1 (hpre.sameShape.1 r (List.mem_range.2 hc.1) hc)
      simp only [mvTo, hcr, Option.getD_some, Holder.place.injEq] at hh
      subst hh
      have hr' := corr_partOf hwf hpre.dstUsable.lt (r + 1) r r' (Nat.lt_succ_self r) hcr
      have hxr := hheld x y₀ r hy₀ ya₀ ho₀ e
        (usable_of_partOf hwf (r + 1) r src (Nat.lt_succ_self r) hc hpre.srcUsable)
      rw [transfer_D]; simp only [not_partOf_src hwf hpre.disjoint hr', ↓reduceIte]
      exact List.mem_append_right _ (mem_movedTo.2 ⟨r, hc, hcr, hxr⟩)
  · simp only [hc, ↓reduceIte] at hh
    have hqs : ¬ partOf s.P q src := by rw [hh] at hc; exact hc
    have hxq := hheld x y₀ q hy₀ ya₀ ho₀ hh (transfer_usable_back hwf hpre.srcUsable hq)
    rw [transfer_D]; simp only [hqs, ↓reduceIte]
    exact List.mem_append_left _ hxq

preserves `KInv` (§57) and `KAux` (§40, §49.7). Neither hypothesis is a clause of §63:
`transfer_breaks_kinv` shows that §63 does not imply the first, and
`transfer_preserves_of_dst_usable_fails` that `KInv ∧ KAux` and the first do not suffice. -/

    (hinv : KInv s) (haux : KAux s) (hheld : HeldAnchored s)
    (h : TransferStep k src dst s (.ok s')) (hd' : s'.Usable dst) : KInv s' ∧ KAux s' := by
  obtain ⟨hw', hi', -, ha'⟩ := transfer_preserves_wf3_inv3_of_dst_usable hinv haux h hd'
  obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  exact ⟨kInv_of hw' hi' (transfer_anchorOrderHeld hinv.1 hheld hpre), ha'⟩

namespace TransferWitness

/-- Statics of the ownership-cycle counterexample (§47): two leaves owned by frame 0, place 0 and

authority 2 held by place 0. -/

held by the unusable place 3 and covers the leaf of the unusable place 2. -/
theorem cyc3_cycle : ¬ cyc3.Usable 2 ∧ ¬ cyc3.Usable 3 ∧ cyc3.Active 2 ∧

  obtain ⟨hu2, hu3, -, hy⟩ := cyc3_cycle

    have : OptP (cyc3.A[2]?) (fun y => y.active = true) False := by decide
    rw [hy] at this; exact this
  refine ⟨fun hw => ?_, fun hnd => ?_⟩
  · have := hw.holders 2 y hy ya
    rw [hh] at this; exact hu3 this
  · exact hnd 2 y hy ya 2 hu2 2 (by decide) hl

end TransferWitness

open TransferWitness in
/-- §63 as written does not preserve the kernel invariant (§57, §58): under a contract with
`DDSound` (§80), from a reachable state satisfying `KInv ∧ KAux`, an accepted `transfer` reaches
a state violating `KInv` (holder validity §49.8 and `NoDangling` §54 fail,

theorem transfer_breaks_kinv : DDSound Examples.K0 ∧ ∃ s s', Reachable Examples.K0 cycStatics s ∧
    KInv s ∧ KAux s ∧ TransferStep Examples.K0 0 3 s (.ok s') ∧ ¬ KInv s' :=
  ⟨fun _ _ h => (h : False).elim, cyc2, cyc3, cyc2_reachable, cyc2_kInv.1, cyc2_kInv.2,
    cyc2_transfer, fun h => cyc3_not_wf3_noDangling.1 h.1⟩

/-- A state satisfying `KInv ∧ KAux` (§57, §49.7), not reached by kernel steps: frames 1 (current)

frame 0; place 3 owned by the source; destination place 4 owned by frame 1. Authorities 0–4 are
the roots of places 0–4; authority 5, derived from 0, gives frame 1 `Modify` on place 0 and,
through it, on the source; authority 6, derived from the root 3, is held by place 2, with no
anchor anywhere. -/
def ahx : S3 where
  F := [1, 0]
  nF := 2
  P := [⟨none, .frame 0, 0⟩, ⟨none, .place 0, 0⟩, ⟨none, .frame 0, 0⟩, ⟨none, .place 1, 0⟩,
    ⟨none, .frame 1, 0⟩]
  I := fun l => if l = 1 then .init else .uninit
  A := [⟨.modify, none, [0], .frame 0, true⟩, ⟨.modify, none, [1], .place 0, true⟩,
    ⟨.modify, none, [2], .frame 0, true⟩, ⟨.modify, none, [3], .place 1, true⟩,
    ⟨.modify, none, [4], .frame 1, true⟩, ⟨.modify, some 0, [0], .frame 1, true⟩,
    ⟨.modify, some 3, [3], .place 2, true⟩]

  dead := fun _ => false

/-- `transfer(1, 4)` from `ahx` (§63, `ok` effect). -/

end TransferWitness

open TransferWitness in

content.content:
## 49. WF3 — Well-Formedness of Frames, Places, and Authorities

`WF3(s)` is a **predicate on state `s`**. It jointly requires:

1. a nonempty, duplicate-free frame stack, every frame having a valid identity and, except for the base frame, a valid parent; frame-parent relations are well-founded;
2. a place structure whose composition links are valid and **acyclic**; every structural part shares its parent's owner and death marker;
3. valid owners of type frame or place, and **well-founded** ownership chains reaching a live frame for every usable place;
4. footprints consisting exclusively of leaves of existing places;
5. authorities with valid identities and modes, whose existing origins form **acyclic** chains ending at a root authority;
6. `RootChain`: every origin chain of an authority covering a leaf ends at the root of the **same structural root place** as that leaf;
7. `RootHeld`: every usable root place has its active root `Modify` authority, with no origin, held exactly by its owner;
8. holder validity: every active authority is held by a frame present in the stack or by a usable place.

Numerical ordering of identifiers, parent precedence over child in a list, and bounds on generated identifiers may be used **to represent or prove** this well-formedness in a formalization; they are not normative restrictions on place or authority identities. Preservation of `WF3` by a transition is a **required property of transitions**, not an additional clause of the state predicate. `WF3` does not impose any particular physical object layout: that belongs to refinement into the elementary memory machine.

## 50. I1 — Structural Exclusivity

For two active authorities **unrelated by derivation** covering the same leaf, their own modes must both be `Observe`. This rule also applies to leaves identified as `SharedMutable`; their particular mutation is governed by the `writeShared` contract and creates no exception to I1.

Exclusivity of **effective** modes (`effective_exclusive`) is a consequence of I1 and the definition of `effective`, not the definition of I1. On a leaf, two incompatible authorities cannot simultaneously possess incompatible effective rights. The only permitted independent ordinary coexistence is `Observe` / `Observe`.

## 51. I2 — Conservation of Rights

A derived authority covers only a subfootprint of what its origin chain permits and does not elevate its mode. Derivation and splitting restrictions do not allow duplication of an exclusive right over a leaf. Every active authority is linked to a valid origin according to state and reanchoring rules. Partial suspension follows from `effective`.

## 52. I3 — Validity of Anchors and Dependencies

Every explicit anchor of a still-usable place is valid. An operation cannot invalidate an anchor retained by a place that remains usable. Transitive propagation of dependencies from contained values does not change this obligation. Dependencies are not permissions and are insufficient to justify an access.

## 53. I4 — Consumption and Movement

A `Moved` leaf cannot be read as if it still contained its previous value. Moving a value does not preserve two copies of an exclusive authority. Initialization state and authority-exercise state are separate checks.

## 54. Anchor Ordering and Absence of Orphan Rights

`AnchorOrder` and `AnchorOrderHeld` are defined in Section 44. `NoDangling` prohibits an **active** authority from covering a leaf belonging to an unusable place; the invariant does not say that a leaf is initialized. `NoOrphan` requires every active authority held by a place to be connected to a frame in the stack through a **finite, non-repeating chain** of authorities: the first link is held by a live frame, and each active link **structurally covers the entirety** of the place holding the next link. The link need not have an effective mode over that place. `NoOrphan` guarantees neither the exercisability of all stored authorities nor freedom from blocking.

## 55. ArenaInv — Invariant of the Arena Abstraction

`ArenaInv` is an invariant of the **library contract**, not an additional predicate of kernel state. For every live arena:

- `storage` designates an existing, usable place; the footprint of `internal` is exactly the footprint of `storage`;
- `internal` is active, with own mode `Modify`, held by the arena value;
- available leaves and issued regions belong to the administered storage;
- two still-active issuances have disjoint regions; no leaf of a still-issued region simultaneously belongs to `available`;
- every still-issued block authority is a derivative of `internal` complying with exclusivity and validity rules;
- anchor and ownership restrictions are respected.

Arena entries do not, by themselves, constitute an additional storage owner. Two live arenas may cover common leaves when their `internal` authorities are distinct and their effective rights are compatible; no **global** disjointness of arena footprints is imposed.

## 56. Uniqueness of Live Administration

**An authority identity may serve as `internal` for at most one live administrative abstraction**, whether an arena, `HandlePool`, `DataStack`, or another library administrative instance. Before registering a new abstraction, its creation operation must jointly check the absence of that identity from **all relevant registries of live administrations**. Uniqueness concerns the identity of the `internal` authority, not merely possible overlap of footprints: abstractions with distinct `internal` identities are not forbidden merely because their footprints overlap. Library contracts must make the information required for this guard available to the creation operation; checking only an abstraction's own registry is insufficient.

**This guard is not a condition for any safety property in Section 57.** The effective right (Section 43, case 3) already prohibits a second issuance over leaves covered by an active block derived from the same authority. Rather, the guard preserves the **abstraction contract**: without it, simultaneous administration of the same `internal` could cause `reject` instead of `fail`, or reissue a previously released block that the first administration still considers unavailable. It creates neither permissions nor allocations and introduces no general detection of authority cycles. Its physical representation and encapsulation of library registries remain outside the kernel.

## 57. Main Invariant

\[
Inv3 = I1 \land I2 \land I3 \land I4 \land AnchorOrder \land NoDangling
\]

On states reachable from `S3.init statics` under `DDSound(K)`, the kernel guarantees:

\[
WF3 \land Inv3 \land AnchorOrderHeld \land NoOrphan
\]

`ArenaInv` (Section 55) belongs to the library abstraction: it is not included in this main kernel invariant.

I5, associated with pinned storage, remains a **specialized obligation** of `K.Pinned`, not a clause automatically implied by sequential accesses alone. This property is required for reachable states under the declared assumptions. Its correspondence with allocations and bytes requires the refinement defined below.

## 73. O7 — Exiting a Frame

**Preconditions**

1. The current frame is not the initial frame and has a surviving caller.
2. Results that must survive have already been legally transferred to their destinations; no active authority or dependency may remain invalidly attached to locals that are about to die.
3. **No leaf of a place that dies with the frame, including transitively owned storage, is pinned**, either statically (`K.Pinned`) or dynamically (`pin`).
4. Iterated reanchoring of surviving authorities and anchors reaches the **first surviving active origin**, held either by a surviving frame or by a usable place whose terminal owner survives; it is not permitted to skip a surviving origin merely because it is held by a place. The operation is rejected when no suitable surviving origin exists, particularly if the chain reaches a root of the exiting frame.
5. Validity of anchors of surviving values and `AnchorOrderHeld` are checked **in the resulting state**. Other state invariants and resource contracts are respected.

**`ok` effect:**

- the current frame is removed from the stack; its untransferred locals and substorages dying with them become unusable;
- authorities still held by that frame, or by places that have become unusable, are released;
- origins of surviving derived authorities are reanchored to the **first surviving active origin** of their chains, whether held by a frame or a usable place, and the `D` anchors of surviving values are correspondingly reanchored;
- reanchoring changes **neither the footprint nor the own mode** of an authority; parameter identities and relations specific to the frame cease their operational role;
- the calling frame becomes current again.

**Other outcome:** `reject`. Exiting does not entail automatic physical deallocation of all dead places. Deferred cleanup (`defer`) lies outside this kernel. Reanchoring may change the current `origin` relation; protection of a historical borrow lineage during an invocation is a distinct, deferred question.

# XIII. Pinning, Statics, and External Commitments

Pinning forbids certain movements or ends of lifetime. It is not a general guarantee of content immutability.

## 74. O15 — Dynamic Pinning

**Preconditions:** `place` is usable, the current frame has exercisable `Modify` over the relevant leaves, and the operation respects applicable pinning obligations.

**`ok` effect:** A dynamic pinning obligation is installed on the relevant leaves. While it is active, `transfer`, `endUse`, `free`, and `exitFrame` are rejected if they act on leaves it pins; removal of this obligation requires `unpin` under `K.ExternalDone`. Pinning does not make contents immutable. **Other outcome:** `reject`.

Operations O6 `enterFrame` (§72) and O7 `exitFrame` (§73) of
`specs/ERN_Memory_Model_Specification_v0.md`, with the frame rules of §39 and the parameter and
reanchoring rules of §45. Both steps preserve the kernel invariant of §57 (`KInv`) together with
the auxiliary invariant `KAux`. The file also proves entry protection of parameters (§72.3 and
the last paragraph of §72), the release of authorities whose holder dies at the exit (§73
effect, §39), the absence of dangling authorities after the exit (§73, §54), reanchoring to the
first surviving active origin (§73.4, §73 effect), and determinism of both steps (§58).

Helper lemmas live in the namespace `Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Frames`.
-/

namespace Ern.MemoryModel.Access

namespace Frames

/-- `enterFrame` preserves `RootHeldConv` (§40, §49.7, §72): an authority without origin is not
a parameter and keeps its holder; a new root authority is held by the frame owning its local. -/
theorem enter_rootHeldConv (hwf : WF3 s) (hpre : EnterPre s ps ls) (hr : RootHeldConv s) :
    RootHeldConv (enterEff s ps ls) := by
  intro x z l r hx ho hl hrp hlr

  · have ho' : z₀.origin = none := by split at ho <;> exact ho
    have hl' : l ∈ z₀.footprint := by split at hl <;> exact hl
    have hnp : x ∉ ps := fun hp => by
....

/-- `exitFrame` preserves `RootHeldConv` (§40, §49.7, §73): an authority without origin after the
exit had none before, and keeps its footprint and holder. -/
theorem exit_rootHeldConv (hc : RootHeldConv s) (h3 : OriginsSurvive s) :
    RootHeldConv (exitEff s) :=
  hc.transport rfl fun x z' hx ho => by
    obtain ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩ := exit_get hx
    refine ⟨z, hz, ?_, (exitG_same s s.F.tail x z).2.1, (exitG_same s s.F.tail x z).2.2⟩

....
