/-- After an `ok` exit, no active authority covers a leaf of an unusable place (§73, §54):
an active authority survives; the root of its chain survives (§73.4) and, by `RootHeldConv`, is
held by the owner of the root place of the leaf, which is therefore usable after the exit, and so
is every place containing the leaf. -/
theorem exit_noDangling (hwf : WF3 s) (hnd : NoDangling s) (hc : RootHeldConv s)
    (h3 : OriginsSurvive s) : NoDangling (exitEff s) := by
  intro j z hz za q hq l hl hlz
  obtain ⟨y₀, hy₀, rfl⟩ := exit_get hz
  have hs := exitG_active za
  rw [(exitG_same s s.F.tail j y₀).2.1] at hlz
  have hq' : ¬ ({ s with F := s.F.tail } : S3).Usable q := fun hu => hq (exit_usable_iff.2 hu)
  by_cases hq₀ : s.Usable q
  · obtain ⟨hlP, hleaf, hlq⟩ := mem_footprint.1 hl
    obtain ⟨x0, z, r, hx0, hz, hzo, hr, hlr, hfz⟩ := hwf.rootChain j y₀ l hy₀ hlz hleaf
    have hx0o : s.org x0 = none := by simp [S3.org, hz, hzo]
    have hs0 := exit_root_survives h3 (j + 1) j (Nat.lt_succ_self j) hs x0 hx0 hx0o
    have hlz0 : l ∈ z.footprint := (hfz l).2 (mem_footprint.2 ⟨hlP, hleaf, hlr⟩)
    obtain ⟨pr, hpr, hh⟩ := hc x0 z l r hz hzo hlz0 hr hlr
    unfold Survives at hs0; rw [hz] at hs0
    obtain ⟨-, hlive⟩ := hs0
    rw [hh] at hlive
    obtain ⟨pl, pr', hpl, hpr', e1⟩ := hwf.ownerOf hlr
    rw [hpr] at hpr'; cases hpr'
    obtain ⟨pl', pq, hpl', hpq, e2⟩ := hwf.ownerOf hlq
    rw [hpl] at hpl'; cases hpl'
    have hdr : s.dead r = false := by
      rw [← hwf.deadOf hlr, hwf.deadOf hlq]; exact usable_dead hq₀
    have hur : ({ s with F := s.F.tail } : S3).Usable r := usable_of_owner hpr hdr hlive
    exact hq' (S3.Usable.of_same hur hpr hpq (e2.symm.trans e1)
      ((hwf.deadOf hlq).symm.trans (hwf.deadOf hlr)))
  · exact hnd j y₀ hy₀ (exitG_active' hy₀ za) q hq₀ l hl hlz

end Exit

end Frames

/-! ## Preservation of the kernel invariant (§57, §72, §73) -/

/-- `enterFrame` preserves the kernel invariant of §57 (`WF3 ∧ Inv3 ∧ AnchorOrderHeld ∧
NoOrphan`) and the auxiliary `RootHeldConv` (§72). -/
theorem enter_preserves {s s' : S3} {ps : List Nat} {ls : LocalShape} (hk : KInv s)
    (ha : KAux s) (h : EnterStep ps ls s (.ok s')) : KInv s' ∧ KAux s' := by
  obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  obtain ⟨hwf, ⟨hb, hao, hnd⟩, -, -⟩ := hk
  exact ⟨kInv_of (Frames.enter_wf hwf hpre) ⟨Frames.enter_inv3base hwf hb,
    Frames.enter_anchorOrder hwf hao hpre, Frames.enter_noDangling hwf hnd hpre⟩
    hpre.anchorOrderHeld, Frames.enter_rootHeldConv hwf hpre ha⟩

/-- `exitFrame` preserves the kernel invariant of §57 (`WF3 ∧ Inv3 ∧ AnchorOrderHeld ∧
NoOrphan`) and the auxiliary `RootHeldConv` (§73). -/
theorem exit_preserves {k : K} {s s' : S3} (hk : KInv s) (ha : KAux s)
    (h : ExitStep k s (.ok s')) : KInv s' ∧ KAux s' := by
  obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  obtain ⟨hwf, ⟨hb, hao, hnd⟩, -, -⟩ := hk
  exact ⟨kInv_of (Frames.exit_wf hwf hpre.hasCaller hpre.origins)
    ⟨Frames.exit_inv3base hb hpre.anchors,
     Frames.exit_anchorOrder hwf hao hpre.anchors hpre.origins,
     Frames.exit_noDangling hwf hnd ha hpre.origins⟩ hpre.anchorOrderHeld,
    Frames.exit_rootHeldConv ha hpre.origins⟩

/-! ## Determinism (§58, §72, §73) -/

/-- `enterFrame` has one outcome (§58, §72). -/
theorem enterStep_det {s : S3} {ps : List Nat} {ls : LocalShape} {o₁ o₂ : Outcome3 S3}
    (h₁ : EnterStep ps ls s o₁) (h₂ : EnterStep ps ls s o₂) : o₁ = o₂ :=
  Guarded.det h₁ h₂

/-- `exitFrame` has one outcome (§58, §73). -/
theorem exitStep_det {k : K} {s : S3} {o₁ o₂ : Outcome3 S3} (h₁ : ExitStep k s o₁)
    (h₂ : ExitStep k s o₂) : o₁ = o₂ :=
  Guarded.det h₁ h₂

/-! ## Frames (§39) -/

/-- Neither step changes the bottom of the stack (§39: the base frame never exits): `exitFrame`
keeps a nonempty stack with the same last frame. -/
theorem exit_keeps_base {k : K} {s s' : S3} (h : ExitStep k s (.ok s')) :
    s'.F ≠ [] ∧ s'.F.getLast? = s.F.getLast? := by
  obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  refine ⟨hpre.hasCaller, ?_⟩
  show s.F.tail.getLast? = s.F.getLast?
  cases hF : s.F with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons f F₀ => exact (getLast?_cons_ne (by simpa [hF] using hpre.hasCaller)).symm

/-- Neither step changes the bottom of the stack (§39: the base frame never exits):
`enterFrame` pushes the new frame on top. -/
theorem enter_keeps_base {s s' : S3} {ps : List Nat} {ls : LocalShape}
    (h : EnterStep ps ls s (.ok s')) : s'.F.getLast? = s.F.getLast? := by
  obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  exact getLast?_cons_ne hpre.callerLive

/-- An exited frame leaves the stack and is the terminal owner of no usable place (§39, §73 `ok`
effect, first item). -/
theorem exitFrame_frame_gone {k : K} {s s' : S3} (hw : WF3 s) (h : ExitStep k s (.ok s')) :
    s.top ∉ s'.F ∧ ∀ q, s'.Usable q → ¬ FrameOf s' q s.top := by
  obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  obtain ⟨f, F₀, hF⟩ : ∃ f F₀, s.F = f :: F₀ := by
    cases h : s.F with
    | nil => exact absurd h hw.frames.1
    | cons f F₀ => exact ⟨f, F₀, rfl⟩
  have hnd := (List.nodup_cons.1 (hF ▸ hw.frames.2.1)).1
  have htop : s.top = f := by simp [S3.top, hF]
  have hF' : (exitEff s).F = F₀ := by simp [exitEff, hF]
  rw [htop, hF']
  refine ⟨hnd, fun q hq hfq => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨g, hg, hgF⟩ := hq.frameOf
  have e := FrameOf.det hfq hg
  rw [hF', ← e] at hgF
  exact hnd hgF

/-! ## Release at the exit (§73 `ok` effect, §39, §45) -/

/-- `exitFrame_releases_all` (§73 `ok` effect, second item; §39; §45): after an `ok` exit, an
authority held by the exited frame or by a place that is no longer usable is released, with its
holder unchanged (it is not returned to the caller); every active authority has a live holder,
other than the exited frame. -/
theorem exitFrame_releases_all {k : K} {s s' : S3} (hw : WF3 s) (h : ExitStep k s (.ok s')) :
    (∀ (j : Nat) (y : Authority), s.A[j]? = some y →
      (y.holder = .frame s.top ∨ ∃ p, y.holder = .place p ∧ ¬ s'.Usable p) →
      ∃ y', s'.A[j]? = some y' ∧ y'.active = false ∧ y'.holder = y.holder) ∧
    (∀ (j : Nat) (y : Authority), s'.A[j]? = some y → y.active = true →
      HolderLive s' y.holder ∧ y.holder ≠ .frame s.top) := by
  obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  obtain ⟨f, F₀, hF⟩ : ∃ f F₀, s.F = f :: F₀ := by
    cases h : s.F with
    | nil => exact absurd h hw.frames.1
    | cons f F₀ => exact ⟨f, F₀, rfl⟩
  have hnd := (List.nodup_cons.1 (hF ▸ hw.frames.2.1)).1
  have htop : s.top = f := by simp [S3.top, hF]
  have hlive : ∀ hd, HolderLive (exitEff s) hd ↔ HolderLive ({ s with F := s.F.tail } : S3) hd :=
    HolderLive.congr (s := ({ s with F := s.F.tail } : S3)) (s' := exitEff s) rfl rfl rfl
  have hnot : ¬ HolderLive ({ s with F := s.F.tail } : S3) (.frame f) := by
    show f ∉ s.F.tail; rw [hF]; exact hnd
  refine ⟨fun j y hy hh => ?_, fun j y hy ya => ?_⟩
  · have hns : ¬ Survives s s.F.tail j := by
      unfold Survives; rw [hy]; rintro ⟨-, hl⟩
      rcases hh with e | ⟨p, e, hp⟩
      · rw [e, htop] at hl; exact hnot hl
      · rw [e] at hl; exact hp ((hlive (.place p)).2 hl)
    refine ⟨_, by rw [Frames.exit_A_get, hy]; rfl, by simp [exitG, hns], by simp [exitG, hns]⟩
  · obtain ⟨y₀, hy₀, rfl⟩ := Frames.exit_get hy
    have hs := Frames.exitG_active ya
    unfold Survives at hs; rw [hy₀] at hs
    have hl : HolderLive ({ s with F := s.F.tail } : S3) y₀.holder := hs.2
    rw [(Frames.exitG_same s s.F.tail j y₀).2.2]
    refine ⟨(hlive _).2 hl, fun e => ?_⟩
    rw [e, htop] at hl; exact hnot hl

/-! ## No dangling authority after the exit (§73, §54) -/

/-- `exitFrame_no_dangling` (§73, §54): after an `ok` exit, no active authority covers a leaf of
a place that is not usable, in particular of a local of the exited frame or of storage dying with
it. -/
theorem exitFrame_no_dangling {k : K} {s s' : S3} (hw : WF3 s) (hnd : NoDangling s)
    (hc : RootHeldConv s) (h : ExitStep k s (.ok s')) :
    ∀ q, ¬ s'.Usable q → ∀ (j : Nat) (y : Authority), s'.A[j]? = some y → y.active = true →
      ∀ l ∈ footprint s'.P q, l ∉ y.footprint := by
  obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  intro q hq j y hy ya
  exact Frames.exit_noDangling hw hnd hc hpre.origins j y hy ya q hq

/-! ## Reanchoring at the exit (§73.4, §73 `ok` effect, §45) -/

/-- Reanchoring (§73.4; §73 `ok` effect, third and fourth items; §45): after an `ok` exit, a
surviving authority stays active with its own mode, footprint and holder; it keeps no origin if

active authority on a leaf of a place that stops being usable is derived, and blocked by §70.3,
or a root, held by the owner of the root place of the leaf, which would stay usable. -/
theorem EndFree.free_noDangling {k : K} {s : S3} {p auth : Nat} (hw : WF3 s) (hnd : NoDangling s)
    (ha : RootHeldConv s) (hpre : FreePre k s p auth) (hw' : WF3 (freeEff s p)) :
    NoDangling (freeEff s p) := by
  have hU := cleanup_usable (freeS s p)
  intro j z hz za q hq l hl hlz
  obtain ⟨hz₀, hnc, hlive⟩ := free_active hz za
  by_cases hq₀ : ¬ s.Usable q
  · exact hnd j z hz₀ za q hq₀ l hl hlz
  replace hq₀ := Decidable.of_not_not hq₀
  obtain ⟨-, hleaf, hlq⟩ := mem_footprint.1 hl
  have hl₀ : s.Usable l := usable_of_partOf hw (l + 1) l q (Nat.lt_succ_self l) hlq hq₀
  have hl₁ : ¬ (freeS s p).Usable l := fun hu => hq (usable_of_part hw' hlq ((hU l).2 hu))
  cases hzo : z.origin with
  | some o =>
    have hacc := hpre.access j (List.mem_range.2 (lt_of_getElem? hz₀))
    unfold FreeAccessOK OptP at hacc; rw [hz₀] at hacc
    rcases hacc za (by rw [hzo]; simp) ⟨l, hlz, .inr ⟨hleaf, hl₀, hl₁⟩⟩ with e | e
    · exact hnc (.inr e)
    · exact e hlive
  | none =>
    obtain ⟨-, -, r, -, -, -, hr, hlr, -⟩ := hw.rootChain j z l hz₀ hlz hleaf
    obtain ⟨pr, hpr, hh⟩ := ha j z l r hz₀ hzo hlz hr hlr
    have hnf : ¬ FreedPlace s.P p r := by
      rintro (hrp | hown)
      · obtain rfl := eq_of_partOf_root hr hrp
        exact hnc (.inl ⟨l, hlz, .inl hlr⟩)
      · cases hown with
        | @direct _ o _ hpl ho hpart =>
          have e : pr.owner = .place o := by rw [hpr] at hpl; cases hpl; exact ho
          rw [hh, e] at hnc; exact hnc (.inr hpart)
        | @step _ o _ hpl ho hown' =>
          have e : pr.owner = .place o := by rw [hpr] at hpl; cases hpl; exact ho
          rw [hh, e] at hlive
          have := dead_false hlive
          simp only [freeS, Bool.or_eq_false_iff, decide_eq_false_iff_not] at this
          exact this.2 (.inr hown')
    have hd : (freeS s p).dead r = false := by
      simp only [freeS, ← hw.deadOf hlr, dead_false hl₀, Bool.false_or, decide_eq_false_iff_not]
      exact hnf
    have hr₁ : (freeS s p).Usable r := usable_of_owner hpr hd (hh ▸ hlive)
    exact hl₁ ((hU l).1 (usable_of_partOf hw' (l + 1) l r (Nat.lt_succ_self l) hlr ((hU r).2 hr₁)))

/-- `free` preserves the kernel invariant `KInv` (§57) and `KAux` (§40, §49.7) (O13, §70). -/
theorem free_preserves {k : K} {s s' : S3} {p auth : Nat} (hk : KInv s) (ha : KAux s)
    (h : FreeStep k p auth s (.ok s')) : KInv s' ∧ KAux s' := by
  obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  have hw := hk.1
  have hroot := rootPlace_of_ownedRoot hpre.ownedRoot
  refine releases_preserve hk ha (freeS_releases s p) rfl rfl rfl
    (fun q h => by simp only [freeS, Bool.or_eq_false_iff] at h; exact h.1)
    (fun q pl r hq hp => ?_) (fun q _ x hx => hx) (free_anchors hk.2.1.1.2.2.1 hpre)
    (fun r i z pr hrp hur hz _ _ hpr hzh hzf => ?_)
    (free_noDangling hw hk.2.1.2.2 ha hpre)
  · obtain ⟨pr, hpr, hlt, -, hd⟩ := hw.places q pl r hq hp
    have hpo : parentOf s.P q = some r := by simp [parentOf, hq, hp]
    have hf : FreedPlace s.P p r ↔ FreedPlace s.P p q := by
      unfold FreedPlace
      rw [partOf_parent hpo hlt (lt_of_getElem? hpr) hroot.2, ownedIn_parent hw hq hp]
    simp only [freeS, hd, decide_eq_decide.2 hf]
  · have hnf : ¬ FreedPlace s.P p r := fun hf => by
      have := dead_false hur
      simp only [freeS, Bool.or_eq_false_iff, decide_eq_false_iff_not] at this
      exact this.2 hf
    have hc : ¬ ((∃ l ∈ z.footprint, FreedPlace s.P p l) ∨ heldIn s.P p z.holder) := by
      rintro (⟨l, hl, hfl⟩ | hh)
      · obtain ⟨-, -, hlr⟩ := mem_footprint.1 ((hzf l).1 hl)
        rcases hfl with hlp | hown
        · obtain rfl := rootOf_unique hrp hroot hlr hlp
          exact hnf (.inl ⟨hroot.1, .inl rfl⟩)
        · obtain ⟨pl, pr', hpl, hpr', ho⟩ := hw.ownerOf hlr
          exact hnf (.inr (ownedIn_of_owner hpl hpr' ho.symm hown))

import Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Preserve.Common

/-!
# Access kernel: preservation by `derive`, `split` and `release`

O1 `derive` (§60), O2 `split` (§61) and O3 `release` (§62) preserve the kernel invariant `KInv`
(§57) and its auxiliary `KAux`; `split` needs the obligation `DDSound(K)` (§61, §80) for I1 only.
Per-invariant lemmas, the effects of §61 and §62 on effective modes (§43), the failure of I1 after
a `split` without `DDSound` (§61, note), and determinism (§58).
-/

namespace Ern.MemoryModel.Access
  exact addAuth_anchorOrderHeld haoh rfl

/-- `derive` preserves the auxiliary `RootHeldConv` (§40, §49.7, §60 effect: the new authority has
an origin). -/
theorem derive_preserves_rootHeldConv {s s' : S3} {src : Nat} {region : List Nat} {m : Mode}
    (hc : RootHeldConv s) (h : DeriveStep src region m s (.ok s')) : RootHeldConv s' := by
  obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  exact addAuth_rootHeldConv hc rfl

/-- `derive` preserves the kernel invariant `KInv` and `KAux` (§57, §58, §60). -/
theorem derive_preserves {s s' : S3} {src : Nat} {region : List Nat} {m : Mode} (hinv : KInv s)
    (haux : KAux s) (h : DeriveStep src region m s (.ok s')) : KInv s' ∧ KAux s' := by
  obtain ⟨hw, ⟨⟨h1, h2, h3, -⟩, hao, hnd⟩, haoh, -⟩ := hinv
  exact ⟨kInv_of (derive_preserves_wf3 hw h)
    ⟨⟨derive_preserves_exclusivity h1 h, derive_preserves_i2 h2 h, derive_preserves_i3 h3 h,
      i4_always _⟩, derive_preserves_anchorOrder hao h, derive_preserves_noDangling hnd h⟩
    (derive_preserves_anchorOrderHeld haoh h), derive_preserves_rootHeldConv haux h⟩

/-! ## O2 `split` (§61) -/
  exact split_induct AnchorOrderHeld (fun _ _ h _ _ => addAuth_anchorOrderHeld h rfl)
    rs s haoh hx hfp

/-- `split` preserves the auxiliary `RootHeldConv` (§40, §49.7, §61 effect: the new authorities have
an origin). -/
theorem split_preserves_rootHeldConv {k : K} {s s' : S3} {src : Nat} {rs : List (List Nat)}
    (hc : RootHeldConv s) (h : SplitStep k src rs s (.ok s')) : RootHeldConv s' := by
  obtain ⟨hp, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  obtain ⟨x, hx, -, -, hfp⟩ := split_src hp
  exact split_induct RootHeldConv (fun _ _ h _ _ => addAuth_rootHeldConv h rfl) rs s hc hx hfp

/-- `split` preserves the kernel invariant `KInv` and `KAux` (§57, §58, §61) under the obligation
`DDSound(K)` (§57, §80). -/
theorem split_preserves {k : K} (hdd : DDSound k) {s s' : S3} {src : Nat} {rs : List (List Nat)}
    (hinv : KInv s) (haux : KAux s) (h : SplitStep k src rs s (.ok s')) : KInv s' ∧ KAux s' := by
  obtain ⟨hw, ⟨⟨h1, h2, h3, -⟩, hao, hnd⟩, haoh, -⟩ := hinv
  exact ⟨kInv_of (split_preserves_wf3 hw h)
    ⟨⟨split_preserves_exclusivity hdd h1 h, split_preserves_i2 h2 h, split_preserves_i3 h3 h,
      i4_always _⟩, split_preserves_anchorOrder hao h, split_preserves_noDangling hnd h⟩
    (split_preserves_anchorOrderHeld haoh h), split_preserves_rootHeldConv haux h⟩

/-- Adding an authority not covering `p` keeps the effective mode of `src` on `p`, through the
  exact (effAnchorOK_release hx e _).2 (haoh q (release_usable.1 hq) e y₀ hy₀ (ea ya).1 (eh ▸ hh))

/-- `release` preserves the auxiliary `RootHeldConv` (§40, §49.7, §62 effect). -/
theorem release_preserves_rootHeldConv {s s' : S3} {a : Nat} (hc : RootHeldConv s)
    (h : ReleaseStep a s (.ok s')) : RootHeldConv s' := by
  obtain ⟨hp, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  obtain ⟨x, hx, -⟩ := hp.active
  exact hc.transport (release_P s a) fun i z' hz hzo => by
    obtain ⟨z₀, hz₀, -, e1, e2, e3, -⟩ := release_back hx hz
    exact ⟨z₀, hz₀, e1 ▸ hzo, e2, e3⟩

/-- `release` preserves the kernel invariant `KInv` and `KAux` (§57, §58, §62). -/
theorem release_preserves {s s' : S3} {a : Nat} (hinv : KInv s) (haux : KAux s)
    (h : ReleaseStep a s (.ok s')) : KInv s' ∧ KAux s' := by
  obtain ⟨hw, ⟨⟨h1, h2, h3, -⟩, hao, hnd⟩, haoh, -⟩ := hinv
  exact ⟨kInv_of (release_preserves_wf3 hw h)
    ⟨⟨release_preserves_exclusivity h1 h, release_preserves_i2 h2 h, release_preserves_i3 h3 h,
      i4_always _⟩, release_preserves_anchorOrder hao h, release_preserves_noDangling hnd h⟩
    (release_preserves_anchorOrderHeld haoh h), release_preserves_rootHeldConv haux h⟩

/-- Restoration of rights by `release` (§62 effect, §26, §32): if `b`, derived from `a`, is the
    rcases h0 with rfl | h0
    · exact hq (by decide)
    · simp [chain, chainF] at h0
  · rw [hA] at hy; obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := get_one hy; cases hh

/-- `cs0` satisfies the auxiliary `KAux` (§40, §49.7). -/
theorem cs0_kAux : KAux cs0 := by
  intro x z l r hx _ _ hr _
  rw [cs0_A] at hx; obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := get_one hx
  have : r = 0 := by have := hr.1; rw [cs0_P] at this; exact Nat.lt_one_iff.1 this
  subst this
  exact ⟨_, by rw [cs0_P]; rfl, rfl⟩

end SplitWithoutDD

open SplitWithoutDD in
/-- Without the obligation `DDSound(K)` (§61, note; §80), an accepted `split` may violate I1 (§50):
from `S3.init cst`, a state satisfying `KInv` and `KAux` (§57), `split` of the root authority into
two copies of the same leaf, declared disjoint by `KDD`, is `ok` and reaches a state with two
active unrelated `Modify` authorities on that leaf. -/
theorem split_unsound_without_DD :
    ¬ DDSound KDD ∧ KInv cs0 ∧ KAux cs0 ∧
      SplitStep KDD 0 [[0], [0]] cs0 (.ok (splitEff cs0 0 [[0], [0]])) ∧
      Reachable KDD cst (splitEff cs0 0 [[0], [0]]) ∧ ¬ I1 (splitEff cs0 0 [[0], [0]]) := by
  have hstep : SplitStep KDD 0 [[0], [0]] cs0 (.ok (splitEff cs0 0 [[0], [0]])) :=
    .ok (by decide)
  refine ⟨fun h => h [0] [0] trivial 0 (List.mem_singleton_self 0) (List.mem_singleton_self 0),
    cs0_kInv, cs0_kAux, hstep, .step .init (.split hstep), fun h => ?_⟩
  have := h 1 2 ⟨.modify, some 0, [0], .frame 0, true⟩ ⟨.modify, some 0, [0], .frame 0, true⟩ 0
    (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) rfl rfl (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide)
  cases this.1

end Ern.MemoryModel.Access

import Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Preserve.Common

/-!
# Access kernel: preservation by `depend`, `store`, `read`, `write`, `writeShared`, `pin`, `unpin`

Every `ok` step of O5 `depend` (§64), O8 `store` (§65), O9 `read` (§66), O10 `write` (§67), O11
`writeShared` (§68), O15 `pin` (§74) and O16 `unpin` (§75) preserves the kernel invariant `KInv`
of §57 and the auxiliary invariant `KAux` (§58: an `ok` transition preserves the relevant
invariants). Per-invariant lemmas come first, then the clause-level properties of these operations
and their determinism (§58).
-/

namespace Ern.MemoryModel.Access

/-! ## Transport of the invariants (§44, §49–§54) -/

/-- Equal authority lists have the same skeletons (§42). -/
private theorem skel_of_A {s s' : S3} (hA : s'.A = s.A) : SameSkel s s' :=
  ⟨by rw [hA], fun j => by rw [hA]⟩

  simp only [skel, Prod.mk.injEq] at e
  rw [hP] at hl
  exact h j y0 hy0 (by rw [← e.2.2.2]; exact ya) q
    (fun hu => hq ((S3.Usable.congr hP hF hd).2 hu)) l hl (by rw [← e.2.2.1]; exact hly)

/-- `RootHeldConv` (§40, §49.7) carries over to a state with the same places whose authorities
with no origin are authorities of the previous state. -/
private theorem rootHeldConv_of {s s' : S3} (h : RootHeldConv s) (hP : s'.P = s.P)
    (hroot : ∀ (i : Nat) (z : Authority), z.origin = none → s'.A[i]? = some z → s.A[i]? = some z) :
    RootHeldConv s' :=
  h.transport hP fun x z hx hzo => ⟨z, hroot x z hzo hx, hzo, rfl, rfl⟩

/-- The conjuncts of `KInv` (§57) and `KAux` give `KInv ∧ KAux`; `NoOrphan` follows from `WF3`
(§54). -/
private theorem kinv_of_parts {s : S3} (hb : WF3 s ∧ Inv3base s) (ho : AnchorOrder s)
    (hn : NoDangling s) (hh : AnchorOrderHeld s) (hc : RootHeldConv s) : KInv s ∧ KAux s :=
  ⟨kInv_of hb.1 ⟨hb.2, ho, hn⟩ hh, hc⟩

/-! ## Steps that keep the authorities (§64, §67, §68, §74, §75) -/

/-- `WF3` (§49) and `I1`–`I4` (§50–§53) carry over to a state with the same authorities, places,
stack, fresh frame bound and death markers, whose anchors of usable places are active. -/
private theorem sameA_base {s s' : S3} (hw : WF3 s) (hi : Inv3base s) (hA : s'.A = s.A)
    (hP : s'.P = s.P) (hF : s'.F = s.F) (hn : s'.nF = s.nF) (hd : s'.dead = s.dead)
    (hD : ∀ q : Nat, s.Usable q → ∀ x ∈ s'.D q, s.Active x) : WF3 s' ∧ Inv3base s' :=
  ⟨wf3_skel hw (skel_of_A hA) hP hF hn hd (fun _ _ _ => by rw [hA])
      fun a y hy ya => hw.holders a y (by rw [← hA]; exact hy) ya,
    inv3base_skel hi (skel_of_A hA) hP hF hd hD⟩

/-- `AnchorOrderHeld` (§44) carries over to a state with the same authorities, places, stack and
death markers. -/
private theorem sameA_anchorOrderHeld {s s' : S3} (h : AnchorOrderHeld s) (hA : s'.A = s.A)
    (hP : s'.P = s.P) (hF : s'.F = s.F) (hd : s'.dead = s.dead) : AnchorOrderHeld s' :=
  anchorOrderHeld_of h hP hF hd (effAnchorOK_of_A hA hP hF)
    fun _ y' hy ya => ⟨y', by rw [← hA]; exact hy, ya, rfl⟩

/-- `RootHeldConv` (§40, §49.7) carries over to a state with the same authorities and places. -/
private theorem sameA_rootHeldConv {s s' : S3} (h : RootHeldConv s) (hA : s'.A = s.A)
    (hP : s'.P = s.P) : RootHeldConv s' :=
  rootHeldConv_of h hP fun _ _ _ hz => by rw [← hA]; exact hz

/-! ## O5 `depend` (§64) -/

/-- The anchors after `depend(q, x)` (§64, `ok` effect): those before, and `x` on `q`. -/
private theorem depend_D {s : S3} {q x r y : Nat} (hy : y ∈ (dependEff s q x).D r) :
    y ∈ s.D r ∨ (r = q ∧ y = x) := by
  simp only [dependEff] at hy
  split at hy
  · rename_i hrq
    rcases List.mem_append.1 hy with hy | hy
    · exact .inl (hrq ▸ hy)
    · exact .inr ⟨hrq, List.mem_singleton.1 hy⟩
  · exact .inl hy

/-- `depend` preserves `WF3` (§49) and `I1`–`I4` (§50–§53): only `D` changes, and the new anchor
is active (§64.2). -/
theorem depend_preserves_base {s s' : S3} {q x : Nat} (hw : WF3 s) (hi : Inv3base s)
    (h : DependStep q x s (.ok s')) : WF3 s' ∧ Inv3base s' := by
  obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  have i3 := hi.2.2.1
  refine sameA_base hw hi rfl rfl rfl rfl rfl fun r hr y hy => ?_
  rcases depend_D hy with hy | ⟨-, rfl⟩
  · exact i3 r hr y hy
  · exact hpre.anchorActive

/-- `depend` preserves `AnchorOrder` (§44): the new anchor satisfies §64.3. -/
theorem depend_preserves_anchorOrder {s s' : S3} {q x : Nat} (hao : AnchorOrder s)
    (h : DependStep q x s (.ok s')) : AnchorOrder s' := by
  obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  refine anchorOrder_of (s := s) rfl rfl rfl (effAnchorOK_of_A rfl rfl rfl) fun r hr y hy => ?_
  rcases depend_D hy with hy | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
  · exact hao r hr y hy
  · exact hpre.anchorOrder

/-- `depend` preserves `NoDangling` (§54): authorities and places are unchanged. -/
theorem depend_preserves_noDangling {s s' : S3} {q x : Nat} (hnd : NoDangling s)
    (h : DependStep q x s (.ok s')) : NoDangling s' := by
  obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  exact noDangling_skel hnd (skel_of_A rfl) rfl rfl rfl

/-- `depend` preserves `AnchorOrderHeld` (§44): authorities and places are unchanged. -/
theorem depend_preserves_anchorOrderHeld {s s' : S3} {q x : Nat} (haoh : AnchorOrderHeld s)
    (h : DependStep q x s (.ok s')) : AnchorOrderHeld s' := by
  obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  exact sameA_anchorOrderHeld haoh rfl rfl rfl rfl

/-- `depend` preserves `RootHeldConv` (§40, §49.7): authorities and places are unchanged. -/
theorem depend_preserves_rootHeldConv {s s' : S3} {q x : Nat} (hc : RootHeldConv s)
    (h : DependStep q x s (.ok s')) : RootHeldConv s' := by
  obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  exact sameA_rootHeldConv hc rfl rfl

/-- `depend` preserves `KInv` (§57) and `KAux` (§58, §64). -/
theorem depend_preserves {s s' : S3} {q x : Nat} (hinv : KInv s) (haux : KAux s)
    (h : DependStep q x s (.ok s')) : KInv s' ∧ KAux s' := by
  obtain ⟨hw, ⟨hb, ho, hnd⟩, hh, -⟩ := hinv
  exact kinv_of_parts (depend_preserves_base hw hb h) (depend_preserves_anchorOrder ho h)
    (depend_preserves_noDangling hnd h) (depend_preserves_anchorOrderHeld hh h)
    (depend_preserves_rootHeldConv haux h)

/-- `depend_preserves_anchor_validity` (§64.2, §52): `I3` is preserved and every authority keeps
its activity, so a declared dependency extends no lifetime. -/
theorem depend_preserves_anchor_validity {s s' : S3} {q x : Nat} (hi3 : I3 s)

/-- `store` preserves `AnchorOrderHeld` (§44): it is the resulting-state precondition §65.5. -/
theorem store_preserves_anchorOrderHeld {s s' : S3} {a p : Nat} (h : StoreStep a p s (.ok s')) :
    AnchorOrderHeld s' := by
  obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  exact hpre.anchorOrderHeld

/-- `store` preserves `RootHeldConv` (§40, §49.7): a root authority is never stored (§65.1). -/
theorem store_preserves_rootHeldConv {s s' : S3} {a p : Nat} (hc : RootHeldConv s)
    (h : StoreStep a p s (.ok s')) : RootHeldConv s' := by
  obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  obtain ⟨y, hy, -, ho, -⟩ := store_pre_auth hpre.derivedHeld
  exact rootHeldConv_of hc (store_eqs s a p).1 fun i z hzo hz => (store_root hy ho i z hzo).1 hz

/-- `store` preserves `KInv` (§57) and `KAux` (§58, §65). -/
theorem store_preserves {s s' : S3} {a p : Nat} (hinv : KInv s) (haux : KAux s)
    (h : StoreStep a p s (.ok s')) : KInv s' ∧ KAux s' := by
  obtain ⟨hw, ⟨hb, ho, hnd⟩, -, -⟩ := hinv
  exact kinv_of_parts (store_preserves_base hw hb h) (store_preserves_anchorOrder hw ho h)
    (store_preserves_noDangling hnd h) (store_preserves_anchorOrderHeld h)
    (store_preserves_rootHeldConv haux h)

/-- `store_writes_one_leaf` (§65.2, §65 `ok` effect): the target is a leaf, it becomes `Init`,
and no other leaf changes its initialization state. -/
theorem store_writes_one_leaf {s s' : S3} {a p : Nat} (h : StoreStep a p s (.ok s')) :
    isLeaf s.P p ∧ s'.I p = .init ∧ ∀ l, l ≠ p → s'.I l = s.I l := by
  obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  obtain ⟨y, hy, -⟩ := store_pre_auth hpre.derivedHeld
  rw [storeEff_eq hy]
  exact ⟨hpre.leaf, by simp, fun l hl => by simp [hl]⟩

/-- `store_keeps_target_reachable` (§65.5): after an accepted `store`, the current frame has
exercisable `Modify` over the target. -/
theorem store_keeps_target_reachable {s s' : S3} {a p : Nat} (h : StoreStep a p s (.ok s')) :
    HasRight s' .modify p := by
  obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  exact hpre.keepsTarget

/-- §65.2: `store` into a target that holds an active authority is rejected. -/
theorem store_occupied_rejected {s : S3} {a p j : Nat} {z : Authority} (hz : s.A[j]? = some z)
    (za : z.active = true) (hzp : z.holder = .place p) : StoreStep a p s .reject :=
  .reject fun hpre => by
    have := hpre.free j (List.mem_range.2 (lt_of_getElem? hz))
    simp only [OptP, hz] at this
    exact this za hzp

/-- §65.1: a root authority (no origin) is never stored. -/
theorem store_root_rejected {s : S3} {a p : Nat} {y : Authority} (hy : s.A[a]? = some y)
    (ho : y.origin = none) : StoreStep a p s .reject :=
  .reject fun hpre => by
    obtain ⟨y', hy', -, ho', -⟩ := store_pre_auth hpre.derivedHeld
    rw [hy] at hy'; cases hy'; exact ho' ho

/-- Determinism of `store` (§58, §65): one outcome. -/
theorem store_det {a p : Nat} {s : S3} {o₁ o₂ : Outcome3 S3} (h₁ : StoreStep a p s o₁)
    (h₂ : StoreStep a p s o₂) : o₁ = o₂ := Guarded.det h₁ h₂

/-! ## O9 `read` (§66) -/

/-- `read_preserves_state` (§66, `ok` effect): an accepted read leaves the state unchanged, in
particular `F`, `P`, `I`, `A` and `D`. -/
theorem read_preserves_state {s s' : S3} {a : Nat} {ls : List Nat}
    (h : Read3Step a ls s (.ok s')) : s' = s := (Guarded.ok_iff.1 h).2

/-- `read` preserves `KInv` (§57) and `KAux` (§58, §66). -/
theorem read_preserves {s s' : S3} {a : Nat} {ls : List Nat} (hinv : KInv s) (haux : KAux s)
    (h : Read3Step a ls s (.ok s')) : KInv s' ∧ KAux s' := by
  rw [read_preserves_state h]; exact ⟨hinv, haux⟩

/-- Determinism of `read` (§58, §66): one outcome. -/
theorem read_det {a : Nat} {ls : List Nat} {s : S3} {o₁ o₂ : Outcome3 S3}
    (h₁ : Read3Step a ls s o₁) (h₂ : Read3Step a ls s o₂) : o₁ = o₂ := Guarded.det h₁ h₂

/-! ## O10 `write`, O11 `writeShared` (§67, §68) -/

/-- The write effect preserves `WF3` (§49) and `I1`–`I4` (§50–§53): only `I` changes (§67, §68
`ok` effects). -/
theorem write3Eff_preserves_base {s : S3} (ls : List Nat) (hw : WF3 s) (hi : Inv3base s) :
    WF3 (write3Eff s ls) ∧ Inv3base (write3Eff s ls) :=
  sameA_base hw hi rfl rfl rfl rfl rfl fun q hq x hx => hi.2.2.1 q hq x hx

/-- The write effect preserves `AnchorOrder` (§44): only `I` changes (§67, §68). -/
theorem write3Eff_preserves_anchorOrder {s : S3} (ls : List Nat) (hao : AnchorOrder s) :
    AnchorOrder (write3Eff s ls) :=
  anchorOrder_of (s := s) rfl rfl rfl (effAnchorOK_of_A rfl rfl rfl) fun q hq x hx =>
    hao q hq x hx

/-- The write effect preserves `NoDangling` (§54): only `I` changes (§67, §68). -/
theorem write3Eff_preserves_noDangling {s : S3} (ls : List Nat) (hnd : NoDangling s) :
    NoDangling (write3Eff s ls) :=
  noDangling_skel hnd (skel_of_A rfl) rfl rfl rfl

/-- The write effect preserves `AnchorOrderHeld` (§44): only `I` changes (§67, §68). -/
theorem write3Eff_preserves_anchorOrderHeld {s : S3} (ls : List Nat) (h : AnchorOrderHeld s) :
    AnchorOrderHeld (write3Eff s ls) :=
  sameA_anchorOrderHeld h rfl rfl rfl rfl

/-- The write effect preserves `RootHeldConv` (§40, §49.7): only `I` changes (§67, §68). -/
theorem write3Eff_preserves_rootHeldConv {s : S3} (ls : List Nat) (h : RootHeldConv s) :
    RootHeldConv (write3Eff s ls) :=
  sameA_rootHeldConv h rfl rfl

/-- The write effect preserves `KInv` (§57) and `KAux` (§67, §68 `ok` effects). -/
private theorem write3Eff_preserves {s : S3} (ls : List Nat) (hinv : KInv s) (haux : KAux s) :
    KInv (write3Eff s ls) ∧ KAux (write3Eff s ls) := by
  obtain ⟨hw, ⟨hb, ho, hnd⟩, hh, -⟩ := hinv
  exact kinv_of_parts (write3Eff_preserves_base ls hw hb) (write3Eff_preserves_anchorOrder ls ho)
    (write3Eff_preserves_noDangling ls hnd) (write3Eff_preserves_anchorOrderHeld ls hh)
    (write3Eff_preserves_rootHeldConv ls haux)

/-- `write` preserves `KInv` (§57) and `KAux` (§58, §67). -/
theorem write_preserves {s s' : S3} {a : Nat} {ls : List Nat} (hinv : KInv s) (haux : KAux s)
    (h : Write3Step a ls s (.ok s')) : KInv s' ∧ KAux s' := by
  obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  exact write3Eff_preserves ls hinv haux

/-- `writeShared` preserves `KInv` (§57) and `KAux` (§58, §68: authorities and I1 do not
change). -/
theorem writeShared_preserves {k : K} {s s' : S3} {a : Nat} {ls : List Nat} (hinv : KInv s)
    (haux : KAux s) (h : WriteSharedStep k a ls s (.ok s')) : KInv s' ∧ KAux s' := by
  obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h

effective `Modify` and no other authority has an effective mode. -/

§75). -/

§75). -/

import Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Preserve.Common

/-!
# Access kernel: `alloc` (O14)

Results on `alloc provider owner shape` of `specs/ERN_Memory_Model_Specification_v0.md` §71 and
on the outcomes of §58: the `ok` outcome preserves the main invariant of §57 (`KInv`) together
with its auxiliary `KAux`; it adds exactly one root place and exactly one authority, the root
`Modify` authority of that place, with no origin, held by `owner`, the new leaves `Uninit` (§71,
`ok`); `fail` happens only when the static preconditions hold and `K.Satisfiable` is false, and
produces no new state (§58, §71); `alloc` is deterministic; no other kernel operation O1–O16
yields `fail` (§58). Helper lemmas live in the namespace `Alloc`.
-/

namespace Ern.MemoryModel.Access

namespace Alloc

/-! ## Shape of the new places (§71.1, §71 `ok`) -/

  rcases allocA_get hst hx with ⟨-, hx'⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
  · have hq0 : s.Usable q := by have := hw.holders x y hx' ya; rw [hh] at this; exact this
    rw [pframe_old hw hq0.lt]
    exact effAnchorOK_old hst hw (h q hq0 x y hx' ya hh)
  · cases hh
    exact effAnchorOK_new hst

/-- `alloc` preserves the auxiliary `RootHeldConv` (§40, §49.7, §71 `ok`): the new root authority
covers only leaves of the new root place, whose owner `owner` holds it. -/
theorem rootHeldConv (hst : AllocStatic k s pr ow ls) (hw : WF3 s) (hc : RootHeldConv s) :
    RootHeldConv (allocEff s ow ls) := by
  intro x z l r hx ho hl hr hlr
  rcases allocA_get hst hx with ⟨-, hx'⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
  · have hlt := (hw.footprints x z hx' l hl).1
    have hlr' := (partOf_old hlt).1 hlr
    have hrl : r < s.P.length := by
      rcases hlr'.2 with rfl | hc'
      · exact hlt
      · exact Nat.lt_trans (chain_lt hc') hlt
    have hr' : RootPlace s.P r :=
      ⟨hrl, by rw [← parentOf_lt (ow := ow) (ls := ls) hrl]; exact hr.2⟩
    obtain ⟨pr', hpr, hh⟩ := hc x z l r hx' ho hl hr' hlr'
    exact ⟨pr', by show (allocP s ow ls)[r]? = _; rw [allocP_lt hrl]; exact hpr, hh⟩
  · obtain rfl := rootOf_unique hr (root_new hst) hlr (mem_footprint.1 hl).2.2
    exact ⟨_, allocP_root hst, rfl⟩

end Preserve

/-- No `Guarded` transition yields `fail` (§58). -/
theorem guarded_ne_fail {σ : Type} {Pre : Prop} {eff : σ} : ¬ Guarded Pre eff .fail :=
  fun h => by cases h

end Alloc

/-! ## Main results (§57, §58, §71) -/

/-- `alloc` preserves the main invariant (§57, §58: an `ok` transition preserves the invariants;
§71.3: the new identities and ownership relations respect `WF3` and `RootHeld`): from a state
satisfying `KInv` and `KAux`, the `ok` outcome of `alloc` satisfies both. -/
theorem alloc_preserves {k : K} {pr ow : Nat} {ls : LocalShape} {s s' : S3}
    (hk : KInv s) (ha : KAux s) (h : AllocStep k pr ow ls s (.ok s')) : KInv s' ∧ KAux s' := by
  cases h with
  | ok hst _ =>
    obtain ⟨hw, ⟨⟨h1, h2, h3, -⟩, hao, hnd⟩, haoh, -⟩ := hk
    exact ⟨kInv_of (Alloc.wf3 hst hw)
        ⟨⟨Alloc.i1 hst hw h1, Alloc.i2 hst h2, Alloc.i3 hw h3, i4_always _⟩,
          Alloc.anchorOrder hst hw hao, Alloc.noDangling hst hw hnd⟩
        (Alloc.anchorOrderHeld hst hw haoh),
      Alloc.rootHeldConv hst hw ha⟩

/-- The `ok` effect of `alloc` (§71, `ok`): the former places are kept and the nonempty shape is
appended with fresh identities, every new place owned by `owner`; among the new places exactly
one, `|P|`, is a root place (a new storage root); exactly one authority is added, at the fresh
identity `|A|`: the root `Modify` authority of `|P|`, with no origin, held by `owner`, covering
the footprint of `|P|`; the leaves of `|P|` are `Uninit`. -/
theorem alloc_one_root {k : K} {pr ow : Nat} {ls : LocalShape} {s s' : S3}
    (h : AllocStep k pr ow ls s (.ok s')) :
    s'.P.length = s.P.length + ls.length ∧ 0 < ls.length ∧
    (∀ q < s.P.length, s'.P[q]? = s.P[q]?) ∧
    (∀ (q : Nat) (pl : Place), s.P.length ≤ q → s'.P[q]? = some pl → pl.owner = .place ow) ∧
    RootPlace s'.P s.P.length ∧
    (∀ r, s.P.length ≤ r → RootPlace s'.P r → r = s.P.length) ∧
    s'.A = s.A ++ [⟨.modify, none, footprint s'.P s.P.length, .place ow, true⟩] ∧
    ∀ l ∈ footprint s'.P s.P.length, s'.I l = .uninit := by
  cases h with
  | ok hst _ =>

  obtain ⟨y, hy, ya⟩ := h3 q' hq₀ x hx₀
  have hc := hpre.anchors q' (List.mem_range.2 hq₀.lt) hq x hx
  unfold ContentAnchorOK OptP at hc; rw [hy] at hc
  obtain ⟨hnh, -, hl⟩ := hc
  exact ⟨y, by rw [endUseEff, EndFree.cleanup_get, EndFree.endUseS_get, hy]; simp [hnh, hl], ya⟩

/-- The end of the content preserves `NoDangling` (§54, §69; HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.3), under
`WF3` (§49) and `RootHeldConv` (§40): an active authority on a leaf of a place that stops being
usable is derived, and blocked by §69.2 on dying storage, or a root, held by the owner of the root
place of the leaf, which stays usable. -/
theorem contentEnd_noDangling {k : K} {s : S3} {q i : Nat} (hw : WF3 s) (hnd : NoDangling s)
    (ha : RootHeldConv s) (hpre : ContentEndPre k s q i) (hw' : WF3 (endUseEff s q)) :
    NoDangling (endUseEff s q) := by
  have hU := EndFree.cleanup_usable (endUseS s q)
  intro j z hz za q' hq l hl hlz
  obtain ⟨hz₀, hnh, hlive⟩ := EndFree.endUse_active hz za
  by_cases hq₀ : ¬ s.Usable q'
  · exact hnd j z hz₀ za q' hq₀ l hl hlz
  replace hq₀ := Decidable.of_not_not hq₀
  obtain ⟨-, hleaf, hlq⟩ := mem_footprint.1 hl
  have hl₀ : s.Usable l := usable_of_partOf hw (l + 1) l q' (Nat.lt_succ_self l) hlq hq₀
  have hl₁ : ¬ (endUseS s q).Usable l := fun hu => hq (usable_of_part hw' hlq ((hU l).2 hu))
  cases hzo : z.origin with
  | some o =>
    have hacc := hpre.dying j (List.mem_range.2 (lt_of_getElem? hz₀))
    unfold DyingAccessOK OptP at hacc; rw [hz₀] at hacc
    rcases hacc za (by rw [hzo]; simp) ⟨l, hlz, hleaf, hl₀, hl₁⟩ with e | e
    · exact hnh e
    · exact e hlive
  | none =>
    obtain ⟨-, -, r, -, -, -, hr, hlr, -⟩ := hw.rootChain j z l hz₀ hlz hleaf
    obtain ⟨pr, hpr, hh⟩ := ha j z l r hz₀ hzo hlz hr hlr
    have hnown : ¬ OwnedIn s.P q r := fun hown => by
      cases hown with
      | @direct _ o _ hpl ho hpart =>
        have e : pr.owner = .place o := by rw [hpr] at hpl; cases hpl; exact ho
        rw [hh, e] at hnh; exact hnh hpart
      | @step _ o _ hpl ho hown' =>
        have e : pr.owner = .place o := by rw [hpr] at hpl; cases hpl; exact ho
        rw [hh, e] at hlive
        have := EndFree.dead_false hlive
        simp only [endUseS, Bool.or_eq_false_iff, decide_eq_false_iff_not] at this
        exact this.2 hown'
    have hd : (endUseS s q).dead r = false := by
      simp only [endUseS, ← hw.deadOf hlr, EndFree.dead_false hl₀, Bool.false_or,
        decide_eq_false_iff_not]
      exact hnown
    have hr₁ : (endUseS s q).Usable r := EndFree.usable_of_owner hpr hd (hh ▸ hlive)
    exact hl₁ ((hU l).1 (usable_of_partOf hw' (l + 1) l r (Nat.lt_succ_self l) hlr ((hU r).2 hr₁)))

/-- The end of the content of a slot place `q` under `ContentEndPre` preserves the kernel invariant
`KInv` (§57) and `KAux` (§40, §49.7) (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.3: "la préservation des invariants
sous ce droit constitue une obligation explicite"; §69 effect). -/
theorem contentEnd_preserves {k : K} {s : S3} {q i : Nat} (hk : KInv s) (ha : KAux s)
    (hpre : ContentEndPre k s q i) : KInv (endUseEff s q) ∧ KAux (endUseEff s q) := by
  have hw := hk.1
  refine EndFree.releases_preserve hk ha (EndFree.endUseS_releases s q) rfl rfl rfl
    (fun q h => by simp only [endUseS, Bool.or_eq_false_iff] at h; exact h.1)
    (fun q' pl r hq hp => ?_) (fun q' _ x hx => ?_) (contentEnd_anchors hk.2.1.1.2.2.1 hpre)
    (fun r n z pr _ hur hz _ _ hpr hzh _ => ?_)
    (contentEnd_noDangling hw hk.2.1.2.2 ha hpre)
  · obtain ⟨-, -, -, -, hd⟩ := hw.places q' pl r hq hp
    simp only [endUseS, hd, decide_eq_decide.2 (EndFree.ownedIn_parent hw hq hp)]
  · simp only [endUseS] at hx; split at hx
    · simp at hx
    · exact hx
  · have hnh : ¬ heldIn s.P q z.holder := fun hh => by
      have hd := EndFree.dead_false hur
      simp only [endUseS, Bool.or_eq_false_iff, decide_eq_false_iff_not] at hd
      rw [hzh] at hh
      cases ho : pr.owner with
      | frame f => rw [ho] at hh; exact hh
      | place o => rw [ho] at hh; exact hd.2 (.direct hpr ho hh)
    rw [EndFree.endUseS_get, hz]; simp [hnh]

/-! ## Kernel side of the pool operations (§57, §58; HandlePool v0.4 annex) -/

/-- Sequences of kernel steps compose (§57). -/
theorem KSeq.trans {k : K} {s₁ s₂ s₃ : S3} (h₁ : KSeq k s₁ s₂) (h₂ : KSeq k s₂ s₃) :
    KSeq k s₁ s₃ := by

/-- An active authority with no origin is held by the owner of the root place of every leaf it
covers (the converse of `RootHeld` restricted to active authorities), from `WF3` (§49.4, §49.7),
`I1` (§50) and `NoDangling` (§54): the root place is usable, so its root `Modify` authority
(§49.7) covers the leaf, and two distinct active authorities with no origin covering a common leaf
are unrelated by derivation, so by `I1` that root authority would be `Observe`. -/
theorem rootHeldConv_active {s : S3} (hw : WF3 s) (h1 : I1 s) (hnd : NoDangling s) :
    ∀ (x : Nat) (z : Authority) (l r : Nat), s.A[x]? = some z → z.active = true →
      z.origin = none → l ∈ z.footprint → RootPlace s.P r → partOf s.P l r →
      ∃ pr, s.P[r]? = some pr ∧ z.holder = pr.owner := by
  intro x z l r hz za zo hl hr hlr
  obtain ⟨hlP, hleaf⟩ := hw.footprints x z hz l hl
  have hlfr : l ∈ footprint s.P r := mem_footprint.2 ⟨hlP, hleaf, hlr⟩
  have hur : s.Usable r := Decidable.byContradiction fun hu => hnd x z hz za r hu l hlfr hl
  obtain ⟨i, z', pr, hz', za', zo', zm', hpr, hh', hfp'⟩ := hw.rootHeld r hr hur
  by_cases hix : i = x
  · subst hix; rw [hz] at hz'; cases hz'; exact ⟨pr, hpr, hh'⟩
  · have hancs : ∀ j w, s.A[j]? = some w → w.origin = none → s.ancs j = [] :=
      fun j w hj hw0 => by
        have : s.org j = none := by simp [S3.org, hj, hw0]
        simp [S3.ancs, chain_none this]
    have := (h1 i x z' z l hix hz' hz za' za ((hfp' l).2 hlfr) hl
      (by rw [hancs x z hz zo]; simp) (by rw [hancs i z' hz' zo']; simp)).1
    rw [zm'] at this; cases this

  obtain ⟨op, hop⟩ := kstep_iff.1 h
  cases op with
  | transfer src dst => exact .inr ⟨src, dst, hop⟩
  | _ => exact .inl (op_preserves hdd hinv haux hop fun _ _ e => KernelOp.noConfusion e)""",
"""/-- Every operation other than `transfer` preserves `KInv` (§57) from its `ok` outcome, under
`DDSound` (§80, used by `split`, §61). -/
theorem op_preserves {k : K} {op : KernelOp} {s s' : S3} (hdd : DDSound k) (hinv : KInv s)
    (h : op.Step k s (.ok s')) (hnt : ∀ src dst, op ≠ .transfer src dst) : KInv s' := by
  cases op with
  | derive => exact derive_preserves hinv h
  | split => exact split_preserves hdd hinv h
  | release => exact release_preserves hinv h
  | transfer src dst => exact absurd rfl (hnt src dst)
  | depend => exact depend_preserves hinv h
  | enter => exact enter_preserves hinv h
  | exit => exact exit_preserves hinv h
  | read => exact read_preserves hinv h
  | write => exact write_preserves hinv h
  | writeShared => exact writeShared_preserves hinv h
  | pin => exact pin_preserves hinv h
  | unpin => exact unpin_preserves hinv h
  | endUse => exact endUse_preserves hinv h
  | free => exact free_preserves hinv h
  | alloc => exact alloc_preserves hinv h
  | store => exact store_preserves hinv h

§49.7; not a clause of §57) from a state satisfying `KInv` (§57) and `KAux` to its `ok`
outcome. -/
theorem op_preserves_kAux {k : K} {op : KernelOp} {s s' : S3} (hinv : KInv s) (haux : KAux s)
    (h : op.Step k s (.ok s')) : KAux s' := by
  cases op with
  | derive => exact derive_preserves_rootHeldConv haux h
  | split => exact split_preserves_rootHeldConv haux h
  | release => exact release_preserves_rootHeldConv haux h
  | transfer => exact transfer_preserves_kAux haux h
  | depend => exact depend_preserves_rootHeldConv haux h
  | enter => exact enter_preserves_kAux hinv haux h
  | exit => exact exit_preserves_kAux haux h
  | read => exact read_preserves_kAux haux h
  | write => exact write_preserves_kAux haux h
  | writeShared => exact writeShared_preserves_kAux haux h
  | pin => exact pin_preserves_kAux haux h
  | unpin => exact unpin_preserves_kAux haux h
  | endUse => exact endUse_preserves_kAux haux h
  | free => exact free_preserves_kAux haux h
  | alloc => exact alloc_preserves_kAux hinv haux h
  | store => exact store_preserves_rootHeldConv haux h

`KInv` or is an accepted `transfer` (§63), the one exception (`transfer_breaks_kinv`). -/

  obtain ⟨op, hop⟩ := kstep_iff.1 h

  | transfer src dst => exact .inr ⟨src, dst, hop⟩
  | _ => exact .inl (op_preserves hdd hinv hop fun _ _ e => KernelOp.noConfusion e)

(§57) and `KAux`. -/
theorem kstep_preserves_kAux {k : K} {s s' : S3} (hinv : KInv s) (haux : KAux s)
    (h : KStep k s s') : KAux s' := by
  obtain ⟨op, hop⟩ := kstep_iff.1 h
  exact op_preserves_kAux hinv haux hop"""),
("""/-- On a state satisfying `KInv` (§57), `KAux` (§40, §49.7) and `HeldAnchored` (auxiliary, not a
clause of §63 nor of §57), an accepted `transfer` (§63) preserves `KInv ∧ KAux` iff its
destination is usable in the resulting state. The destination usable afterwards is not a clause of
§63 (`transfer_breaks_kinv`); this states exactly when §57 holds after the step. -/
theorem transfer_kinv_iff {k : K} {s s' : S3} {src dst : Nat} (hinv : KInv s) (haux : KAux s)
    (hheld : HeldAnchored s) (h : TransferStep k src dst s (.ok s')) :
    KInv s' ∧ KAux s' ↔ s'.Usable dst :=

    transfer_preserves_of_dst_usable_of_heldAnchored hinv haux hheld h⟩

clause of §63), preserves `KInv` (§57), `KAux` (§40, §49.7) and `HeldAnchored` (auxiliary) under

    (hinv : KInv s) (haux : KAux s) (hheld : HeldAnchored s) (h : op.Step k s (.ok s'))

    KInv s' ∧ KAux s' ∧ HeldAnchored s' := by

    exact ⟨h'.1, h'.2, hh'⟩

    have h' := op_preserves hdd hinv haux h fun _ _ e => KernelOp.noConfusion e
    exact ⟨h'.1, h'.2, hh'⟩""",
"""/-- On a state satisfying `KInv` (§57) and `HeldAnchored` (auxiliary, not a clause of §63 nor of
§57), an accepted `transfer` (§63) preserves `KInv` iff its destination is usable in the resulting
state. The destination usable afterwards is not a clause of §63 (`transfer_breaks_kinv`); this
states exactly when §57 holds after the step. -/

    (hheld : HeldAnchored s) (h : TransferStep k src dst s (.ok s')) :

refinement.md
  `enterFrame` parameters become frame-held.
- **release:** filters only the released anchor.
- **depend:** only adds anchors.
- **store:** anchors the stored authority (§65 effect).
- **transfer:** the Transfer module's theorem.
- **exitFrame:** a surviving anchor maps to itself (`firstSurv (x :: ancs x) = x`).
- **endUse:** an authority that stays active is not held within `p`, so its holder's `D` is kept.
- **free:** keeps `D`.
- **read, write, writeShared, pin, unpin:** keep `A` and `D`.

So P-T2 (Transfer report) cannot occur on `ReachableDU` states. Its counterexample `ahx` is not
reachable by such runs.

## Obligations not proved

None. One point is open, and nothing needs it: whether `HeldAnchored` holds on **every**
`Reachable` state. The preservation proof uses `WF3` before the step, and `WF3` fails after the
ownership-cycle transfer.

## Readings (representation only)

1. **"Every step except transfer" over unlabelled `KStep`** is stated as a disjunction
   (`kstep_preserves`: preserved, or the step is an accepted transfer). Over the labelled
   operations it is `op ≠ .transfer` (`op_preserves`). A hypothesis such as "not a transfer step"
   on `KStep` would exclude pairs `(s, s')` that both a transfer and another operation produce.
   The disjunction avoids that.
2. **§59 "permitted write"** is keyed on the executed operation, not existentially over the
   operations relating `s` and `s'`. "Including during a derived `issue`" is covered by `store`,
   because `issue` is a library operation. The transfer disjunct is read as the draft reads it: a
   destination leaf with a corresponding source leaf `Init` before the step.
3. **§59 global form (`init_history`).** It is stated over an explicit run (`KStar`) through a
   witness step `t → t'`. It does not assert that the leaf stays `Init` after `t'`, or throughout
   in the declared case. That stronger history form was not requested.
4. **§39 "the base frame, whose identity is 0 in states reachable from the initial state, never
   exits"** is read as: the bottom of the stack is 0 on every reachable state
   (`reachable_base`). It needs no invariant, because only `exitFrame` pops a frame and §73.1
   requires a caller.
5. **§58 "only `alloc` may produce `fail`"** is stated over `KernelOp.Step`. "Leaving the state
   unchanged" holds by representation: `Outcome3.fail` carries no state. This is kernel-defs
   reading 47.
6. **`KAux` and `HeldAnchored`** are auxiliary invariants carried through the induction. Neither
   is a clause of §57. Both are discharged on the reachable states of `reachableDU_kinv`, whose
   conclusion contains `KInv` exactly.

### (a) Preservation

| Name | Statement | Clause |
|---|---|---|
| `op_preserves` | `DDSound k → KInv s → KAux s → op.Step k s (.ok s') → (∀ src dst, op ≠ .transfer src dst) → KInv s' ∧ KAux s'` | §57, §58, §60–§75 |
| `kstep_preserves` | over `KStep`: `DDSound k → KInv s → KAux s → KStep k s s' → (KInv s' ∧ KAux s') ∨ ∃ src dst, TransferStep k src dst s (.ok s')` | §57, §58 |
| `op_preserves_heldAnchored` | `WF3 s → HeldAnchored s → op.Step k s (.ok s') → HeldAnchored s'` for **all 16** operations, transfer included | §44, §65, §63, §73 |
| `kstep_preserves_heldAnchored` | the same over `KStep` | §44, §57 |
| `transfer_dst_usable_of_noDangling` | `WF3 s → TransferStep k src dst s (.ok s') → NoDangling s' → s'.Usable dst` | §63.1, §54 |
| `transfer_kinv_iff` | `KInv s → KAux s → HeldAnchored s → TransferStep k src dst s (.ok s') → (KInv s' ∧ KAux s' ↔ s'.Usable dst)` | §57, §63 |
| `op_preserves_of_dst_usable` | `DDSound k → KInv s → KAux s → HeldAnchored s → op.Step k s (.ok s') → (∀ src dst, op = .transfer src dst → s'.Usable dst) → KInv s' ∧ KAux s' ∧ HeldAnchored s'` | §57, §63 |

The strongest true transfer statement is `transfer_kinv_iff`. On states with `KInv ∧ KAux ∧
HeldAnchored`, "destination usable after" is sufficient (the Transfer module's theorem). It is also
**necessary**, because `KInv s'` already gives it through `NoDangling s'`: the §63.1 `Modify`
authority of the current frame over the destination stays active and still covers the destination's
leaves.

### (b) Reachable states

| Name | Statement | Clause |
|---|---|---|
| `reachable_kinv_false` | `¬ ∀ k statics s, DDSound k → StaticsOK statics → Reachable k statics s → KInv s`. Witness: `transfer_breaks_kinv` extended by its transfer step; `StaticsOK cycStatics` is decided. | §57, §63 |
| `KStepDU` (def) | `∃ op, op.Step k s (.ok s') ∧ ∀ src dst, op = .transfer src dst → s'.Usable dst`. The docstring says it is a hypothesis on runs, not a clause of §63 or §57. | §57, §63 |
| `ReachableDU` (inductive) | closure of `KStepDU` from `S3.init statics` | §57 |
| `ReachableDU.reachable` | `ReachableDU ⊆ Reachable` | §57 |
| `kstepDU_iff` | `DDSound k → KInv s → KAux s → HeldAnchored s → (KStepDU k s s' ↔ KStep k s s' ∧ KInv s')` | §57, §63 |
| `reachableDU_kinv` | `DDSound k → StaticsOK statics → ReachableDU k statics s → KInv s ∧ KAux s ∧ HeldAnchored s`, with `KInv = WF3 ∧ Inv3 ∧ AnchorOrderHeld ∧ NoOrphan` | §57, §47 |

`kstepDU_iff` shows that the restriction is exactly "the step keeps §57". From a state where the
invariant holds, a kernel step is a `KStepDU` step iff its resulting state satisfies `KInv`. So,
by induction from `init_kinv`, `ReachableDU` is the set of states reached by runs along which §57
holds at every state. This run-level equivalence is not stated as a separate theorem.

still show the old combined signatures; this file supersedes them.
